blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.
blocks.zh: 一个快速接受分类器可以为速度较慢的评价员选择修改. 我们问,就现有文件达成协议是否支持这种使用。 我们比较了一个单词和文档特性的分类器,与两个发布的仅文本的接受预测器从同一个语言模型中微调了30亿参数. 对于国际学习代表性会议的198篇论文,我们比较了对原始论文和段落进行自动重排的模型排名,以了解未变的事实、主张的力量和归属。 分类者将原始文件与一个预测器进行紧密的排序,与另一个预测器进行中度的排序,但并没有显示任何一种可察觉的协议,因为重写者会提高分数。 预先规定的试验采用了较低的数值精度。 四舍五入的错误在小分数的答复中占主导地位。 因此,我们以32位的精确度将释放的重量重新计分,作为临时检查;编辑协议仍然接近零。 在这种精准度下,当每个预测器在每张纸的5个重写中选择时,其平均原始得分低于比随机选择高100分中的2分. 证据包括一个家庭的列报重写和两个公开预测器;向费用昂贵的评价员的转让仍未经过测试。 因此,应对照预定评价人员对修订工作进行排序检查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Predicting whether a paper will be accepted and deciding how to revise it are different tasks. A predictor may recognize features associated with acceptance across papers without identifying useful changes to any one paper. For example, two scorers could rank the same manuscript highly yet favor different rewrites of its opening paragraph. A revision tool needs evidence about this second comparison: which changes it rewards.
blocks.zh: 预测是否接受一份文件并决定如何修订该文件是不同的任务。 预测者可以识别与接受跨文件有关的特点,而不指明对任何一份文件的有益改动。 例如,两个记分员可以对同一手稿进行高度排序,但倾向于对其开头段落的不同改写。 一个修订工具需要关于这一第二次比较的证据:它能产生什么效果。

blocks.en: We study two text-only models from PaperScorer, which predicts acceptance from manuscript text and page images and presents its outputs as calibrated acceptance estimates ( Konan et al., 2026c ) . The release reports revisions guided by a model’s own feedback. We instead select revisions with a separate, faster classifier and then measure how the two models score them.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了来自PaperScorer的两个只使用文字的模型,它预测了手稿文本和页面图像的接受程度,并将它的输出作为校准的接受估计(Konan等人,2026c). 发行报告根据模型本身的反馈进行修改。 我们选择一个单独的、更快的分类器进行修改,然后衡量两个模型如何评分。

blocks.en: The fast classifier, called the surrogate S S , uses words and document features. The two acceptance models, called the targets T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} , share a base language model but were trained on different paper collections with different prompts. Each target has three billion parameters. We select edits using S S alone; neither target provides feedback during generation or selection.
blocks.zh: 快分类器称为代词S S ,使用单词和文档特性. 两个接受模式,称为目标T1 T_{1}和T2 T_{2}共享一个基础语言模式,但接受了不同速率的纸质集合培训. 每个目标都有30亿个参数。 我们只选择使用 S S 的编辑;在生成或选择过程中,两个目标都不提供反馈.

blocks.en: PaperScorer was the first released predictor we considered, rather than the winner of a comparison among candidates. Its public test split supplies the same original papers for all three scorers, while the two targets share a base model. Text-only inputs let paragraph edits map directly onto the scored input. We use papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR); the page-image and larger released models are outside the tested pair.
blocks.zh: 纸质计分器是我们考虑的第一个发布预测器,而不是在候选人之间进行比较的赢家。 其公开测试分数为全部三个得分者提供相同的原始论文,而两个目标共享一个基模. 只有文本输入允许段落直接编辑到已打入的输入上。 我们使用国际学习表现大会(ICLR)的论文;页面图像和更大的发布模型在测试对面之外.

blocks.en: The open targets let us model a setting in which an author cannot query a costly evaluator repeatedly and uses a cheaper scorer to select revisions. This is a hypothetical use, rather than a documented revision tool. The tested targets are themselves cheap to query; we score them to measure their responses, and transfer to costly evaluators remains untested.
blocks.zh: 开放的目标让我们模拟一个设定,即作者不能反复询问费用昂贵的评估者,并使用更便宜的计分器来选择修改。 这是一个假设的用途,而不是一个有文件记载的修订工具。 被测试的目标本身对查询来说是廉价的;我们为衡量其答复而给它们打分,向昂贵的评价员的转让仍然没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Original-paper agreement may not be sufficient for this use. Two generative reviewers can agree on original-paper scores while agreeing much less on the gains they assign to the same whole-paper revisions ( Yang et al., 2026b ) . Presentation-based attacks also show that wording can be optimized and that some attacks transfer between reviewers ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ) . More generally, models that perform alike on held-out data can generalize differently under distribution shift ( D’Amour et al., 2022 ; McCoy et al., 2020 ) . Unlike whole-paper revisions, single-paragraph rewrites let us compare several alternatives within each paper. We ask whether a classifier that tracks a target’s paper rankings also tracks its responses to those alternatives. We measure agreement about changes, without treating a score response as desirable.
blocks.zh: 原始文件协议可能不足以作此使用。 两位基因审查员可以就原始纸的得分达成一致,而就他们分配给同一全纸修订稿的收益达成一致则少得多(Yang等人,2026b.). 基于演示文稿的攻击也表明,措辞可以优化,一些攻击在审查者之间转移(Yang等人,2026a; Li et al., 2026b ) (中文(中国大陆) ). 更一般地说,在被搁置数据上同样发挥作用的模型可以在分配转移时以不同方式概括(D ' Amour等人,2022年;McCoy等人,2020年)。 与整份文件的修订不同,单段的修改让我们在每份文件中比较几个备选案文。 我们问一个跟踪目标论文排名的分类人员是否也跟踪其对这些选择的反应。 我们衡量关于变化的一致意见,而不把评分答复视为可取。

blocks.en: The same distinction matters for large language model (LLM) judges ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) and learned reward models used to optimize text ( Ziegler et al., 2019 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ) . Their agreement on fixed texts does not establish that they reward the same revisions. Our evidence motivates corresponding tests without establishing how these systems would perform.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)评委(郑等人,2023年;刘等人,2023年)和为优化文本而学习的奖励模式(齐格勒等人,2019年;斯蒂安农等人,2020年)的区别也同样重要. 它们就固定案文达成的协议并未确定它们应获得同样的修订。 我们的证据激励了相应的测试,但没有确定这些系统将如何运作。

blocks.en: Figure 1 maps the three studies. Study 1 compares acceptance prediction and score rankings on original ICLR papers. Study 2 compares rankings of paragraph rewrites that pass automatic preservation checks. Study 3 compares combinations chosen by adaptive and random search, both selecting with the surrogate’s scores.
blocks.zh: 图1列出了这三项研究。 研究1比较了对ICLR原始论文的接受预测和分数排名. 研究2比较了通过自动保存检查的重写段落的排名. 研究3将适应和随机搜索所选择的组合进行对比,两者都与替补的分数进行对比.

blocks.en: The classifier’s agreement on original papers does not extend to agreement about which paragraph rewrites raise the predictors’ scores. Because the score changes are small, the study bounds agreement for these checked rewrites; it does not establish whether any model’s edit preferences are valid.
blocks.zh: 分级人对原始文件的协议并不延伸至关于哪个段落改写会提高预测者的分数的协议。 由于分数变化很小,研究对这些已检查的重写有协议约束;它没有确定任何模型的编辑偏好是否有效.

blocks.en: 2 Evaluators and study design
blocks.zh: 2个 评价员和研究设计

blocks.en: 2.1 Which scorers are compared?
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 哪些得分者是比较的?

blocks.en: The surrogate S S is logistic regression trained on PaperScorer ICLR acceptance labels: 21,141 training papers and 844 validation papers. It combines term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF–IDF) word features from the first 30,000 characters with whole-document counts of length, figures, tables, equations, headings, and citations, plus title and abstract length. The word weights favor terms common within a paper but rare across papers. The surrogate is fitted to these labels only: it is not distilled from target scores and is separate from the feature baseline reported with PaperScorer. Feature settings and regularization are selected by validation area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), without edit outcomes. Supplementary Section S1 gives the full configuration.
blocks.zh: 代号SS是经过PaperScorer ICLR接受标签培训的物流回归:21,141份训练论文和844份验证论文. 它结合了术语频率-反向文档频率(TF-IDF)的前30,000个字符的单词特征和全文件的长度计数,数字,表格,方程式,标题和引用,加上标题和抽象长度. 这个词的权重偏重于论文中常见的术语,但在论文中却罕见. 替代物只配在这些标签上:它不是从目标分数中提炼出来的,而是与PaperScomer报告的特点基线分开的. 特征设置和规范化由接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的验证区域选择,不编辑结果. 补充部分S1给出了完整的配置.

blocks.en: The acceptance models are PaperScorer-3B-Text-OpenReview-ICLR ( T 1 T_{1} ) ( Konan et al., 2026b ) and PaperScorer-3B-Text-arXiv ( T 2 T_{2} ) ( Konan et al., 2026a ) , both released with PaperScorer ( Konan et al., 2026c ) . Both released models are fixed fine-tunes of Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) , using the same base checkpoint and training approach. T 1 T_{1} is trained on ICLR papers; T 2 T_{2} uses arXiv papers associated with several machine learning venues.
blocks.zh: 接受模式为PaperScomer-3B-Text-OpenReview-ICLR(T 1 T_{1}). (Konan等人,2026b)和PaperScoreer-3B-Text-arXiv(T 2 T_{2})(Konan等人,2026a),均与PaperScoreer(Konan等人,2026c)一同发行. 两种发布型号均为Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct的固定微调(Quen等人,2025年),采用相同的基点检查站和培训方法. T1 TQQQQ1}接受过ICLR论文的培训;T2 TXQ2}使用与多个机器学习场所相关的arXiv论文.

blocks.en: Each uses its released prompt and scoring rule. The raw score is the probability of the acceptance token divided by the sum of the acceptance and rejection probabilities (Supplementary Section S1 ). The release also maps this score to a calibrated acceptance estimate by temperature scaling with a term for the prior acceptance rate; we use the raw score, and because that mapping is monotone, within-paper rankings are the same under either.
blocks.zh: 各使用其发布的即时和评分规则. 原始分数是接受符的概率除以接受和拒绝概率之和(补充部分S1). 发行版还将这个分数映射到一个按温度缩放的校准接受估计值中,并用一个术语来表示之前的接受率;我们使用原始分数,并且由于这种映射是单调的,因此纸面内部的排名在两者下都是一样的.

blocks.en: Each fixed input receives one score from each target on an RTX 4090 graphics processing unit (GPU). Inputs longer than the release’s training cutoff of 24,480 tokens are truncated. Table 2 separates the four scoring paths. Our tests use Transformers, a model-inference library ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) ; the release uses vLLM, a model-serving library ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) . The release does not set a precision, so vLLM’s current default uses float16 for these 32-bit checkpoints ( vLLM Project, 2026 ) . Supplementary Section S6.4 gives the precision comparisons.
blocks.zh: 每个固定输入在一个RTX 4090图形处理单元(GPU)上从每个目标得到一个分数. 超过24,480个奖牌的培训截止时间的输入被截断。 表2分别了四个评分路径. 我们的测试使用变形金刚,一个模型参考库(Wolf et al.,2020年);发行使用vLLM,一个模型服务库(Kwon et al.,2023年). VLLM目前默认使用浮点16来设置32位检查站(vLLM Project, 2026), 补充部分S6.4提供了精确的比较。

Brackets are nominal 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs); rank agreement uses Spearman’s correlation ( Spearman, 1904 ) . CPU时间使用前200份基准文件;目标时间使用所有5,321份冻结输入. 这不是一个普通工作负荷硬件基准。

blocks.en: Table 1 motivates S S as a proxy for T 1 T_{1} : their original-paper rankings agree strongly, and their AUCs differ by 0.020. Supplementary Section S6.5 gives the paired AUC comparisons for both precisions.

blocks.en: T 2 T_{2} supplies a second comparison with weaker original-paper agreement with S S (Table 1 ). It scores ICLR text with its released arXiv prompt, and some benchmark titles occur in its training corpus. On its own arXiv test split, our implementation reproduces the reported AUC (0.813 against 0.812 ( Konan et al., 2026a ) ; Supplementary Section S6.5 ).

blocks.en: These qualifications make S S – T 2 T_{2} a weaker premise for revision selection. We therefore treat S S – T 1 T_{1} as the main comparison in our interpretation. This is a post hoc designation; the pre-specified family weighs both targets alike.
blocks.zh: 这些资格使得S – T 2 T_{2)成为修改选用的较弱前提. 因此,我们将S-T 1 T_{1}作为我们解释的主要比较。 这是一个临时的指定;预先指定的家庭对两个目标都权衡。

blocks.en: 2.2 Which papers and inputs are scored?
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 哪些论文和投入得分?

blocks.en: Study 1 uses all 1,667 released ICLR test papers. From the 2026 papers, a seeded selection draws 200 for single edits (Study 2) and a disjoint 128 for search (Study 3). Before selection, we exclude pilot papers and likely training-paper relatives identified by title matches and title-plus-abstract similarity. Table 3 maps the selected and analyzed sets. Supplementary Section S1 gives the exclusions, Table S16 maps the sets, and Section S8 gives the seeds. These exclusions filter identified training families, not unknown base-model pretraining exposure.
blocks.zh: 第1研究使用了所有1,667份发布的ICLR测试论文. 从2026年的论文中,一个种子选集抽取200作为单曲编辑(Sturn 2),一个脱节的128作为搜索(Sturn 3). 在挑选之前,我们排除了试卷和可能的培训文件亲属,这些亲属是按头衔匹配和头衔加抽象相似程度确定的。 表3 绘制了所选和分析的套件。 补充部分S1给出了排除,表S16给出了套图,而S8部分给出了种子. 这些排除因素过滤器确定了培训家庭,并非未知的基本模式培训前暴露。

blocks.en: Table 3: How the analysis sets relate. Study 2 and Study 3 use disjoint papers. The edit rows are nested, so their counts must not be added. The edit-ranking analysis requires at least five admitted edits and nonconstant scores for both compared evaluators. Supplementary Table S16 gives the expanded map.
blocks.zh: 表3:分析组的关系。 研究2和研究3使用脱节论文. 编辑行为巢,故其计数不得加. 编辑排名分析要求两个比较评价者至少获得5个被允许的编辑和非恒定分数. 补充表S16给出了扩展的地图.

blocks.en: We fix every evaluation text and its order before target scoring (Figure 1 ). The scoring program rejects changes to these saved versions, and neither target guides generation, checking, or search. The term sealed refers to edited-input evaluation, not complete prior ignorance of the targets. Both targets had scored the original release texts earlier. Those scores were excluded from sampling, prompt development, edit selection, and search. The protocol was specified locally before edited-input scoring, without public preregistration.
blocks.zh: 在目标评分(图1)之前,我们先确定每个评价文本及其顺序。 评分程序拒绝对这些保存版本的修改,而目标引导生成,检查,或搜索都没有. 封存一词是指编辑输入评价,而不是事先完全不了解目标. 这两个目标在较早时都取得了原始发布文本的得分。 这些分数被排除在取样、迅速开发、编辑选择和搜索之外。 协议在编辑-输入评分前在当地指定,没有公开预先登记.

blocks.en: 2.3 How are edits produced and checked?
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 如何制作和检查编辑?

blocks.en: GPT-6-Luna at maximum reasoning effort is asked for up to 24 paragraph rewrites per paper, each a version that reads more convincingly to reviewers. Each replaces one paragraph and receives a descriptive type label: clarity, flow, structure, emphasis, or framing; rhetorical emphasis may change. The writer must preserve facts, claim strength, attribution, numbers, equations, citations, headings, and figure/table references; it may neither add evidence nor move material between paragraphs. These are instructions, not guarantees or an independently validated taxonomy. Supplementary Section S2 gives the prompts, and Section S2.6 shows two complete original/edited examples selected by a fixed rule.
blocks.zh: 要求GPT-6-Luna在最大程度上进行推理,每份文件最多改写24段,每段都向审查人员宣读更令人信服的版本。 每段替换一段,并获得一个描述性类型的标签:清晰度、流量、结构、重点或框架;言语重点可能改变。 作者必须保留事实、主张力、归属、数字、方程式、引文、标题和数字/表格参考;它既不能增加证据,也不能在段落之间移动材料。 这些是指示,不是保证,也不是独立验证的分类。 补充的S2节给出了提示,而S2.6节显示了由固定规则选择的两个完整的原创/编辑实例.

blocks.en: Study 2 also requests an evidence removal and a length-matched deletion of non-result text, called a sham. The removal deletes whole paragraphs reporting one result that supports a quoted abstract or Introduction claim. The sham deletes background or related work with no results or claims of the paper, matched to within 20% of the removal’s length. Because coverage of prior work is a reviewing criterion, the sham may itself carry a legitimate acceptance cost. This tests the implemented deletion procedure, not scientific understanding in general.
blocks.zh: 研究2还要求删除证据,并长时间删除称为虚假的非结果文本。 删除整个段落,报告一个支持所引抽象索赔或导言索赔的结果。 假的删除背景或相关工作,没有结果或文件要求,与删除长度的20%内相符。 由于前期工作的涵盖范围是一项审查标准,因此虚假本身可能具有合法的接受成本。 这检验了已执行的删除程序,而不是一般的科学理解。

blocks.en: An edit is admitted only if it passes two checks. An invariant check protects numbers, equations, citations, cross-references, headings, and table blocks. A semantic check by GPT-6.1-Sol at high reasoning effort judges whether meaning, claim strength, scope, and attribution remain unchanged. It sees the original and edited text without scorer outputs, and passes an item only when the preservation conditions are judged satisfied. For deletions, only the declared span may disappear, and the remaining paper must stay coherent. Claude Opus 5.5 rechecks a seeded 10% of calls, also without scores. Only this sampled recheck crosses providers; the writer and primary checker share one. Supplementary Section S2 gives the rules, and Section 3 measures their limitations.
blocks.zh: 只有经过两次检查后,编辑才能被接受。 不定的检查保护数字、方程式、引用、交叉引用、标题和表格块。 由GPT-6.1-Sol在高推理努力中进行语义检查,判断意义,要求强度,范围和归属是否保持不变. 它看到原文和经编辑的文本没有记分器输出,只有在判断保存条件满足时才会通过一个项目. 对于删除,只有申报的跨度才能消失,其余的纸张必须保持一致。 Claude Opus 5.5重新检查了10%的种子通话,同样没有得分. 只有这个抽样的重新检查可以交叉提供商;写入器和主检查器共用一个. 补充第S2节规定了规则,第3节规定了限制。

blocks.en: Study 3 uses a one-pass polish by the same writer as a separate control. It may change any paragraph; the same checks are applied to each changed paragraph, and failures revert to the original.
blocks.zh: 研究3采用同一作者的单路抛光作为单独的控制. 它可修改任何段落;对每经修改的段落都适用同样的检查,失败则恢复到原来的段落。

blocks.en: 2.4 How does search select revisions?
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 搜索如何选择修改 ?

blocks.en: Study 3 compares two ways to select combinations of admitted edits. Both use only S S ’s scores and allow at most eight edits, one per paragraph, with total character count changing by at most 5% in either direction. Adaptive search adds the best improving edit that respects those limits at each step; random search tries sampled combinations and keeps the best according to S S . Because both policies select with S S , this contrast tests a search policy rather than surrogate guidance against unguided editing. Supplementary Section S1.3 gives the full algorithms and accounting rules.
blocks.zh: 研究3比较了两种选择被录取编辑的组合的方法. 两人只使用 S S 的分数, 最多允许八次编辑, 每段一次, 总字符数在任一方向最多变化5%。 适应性搜索添加了在每个步骤上尊重这些限制的最佳改进编辑;随机搜索尝试抽样组合,并保持S S 的最好效果. 因为这两种政策都选择了S S ,这个对比测试了一种搜索政策,而不是针对无指导编辑的替代指导. 补充部分S1.3给出了完整的算法和会计规则.

blocks.en: We run two seeds per paper and record choices at maximum allowances of Q ∈ { 1 , 8 , 64 , 512 } Q\in\{1,8,64,512\} surrogate evaluations. Adaptive search can stop early, so the policies need not use the same number of evaluations. The chosen text is called an endpoint. At 64 and 512, the same primary semantic checker judges every nonempty endpoint as a complete document, using the preservation criteria above; failed endpoints contribute zero gain. Endpoints at one and eight lack this final check and are exploratory. The filtered one-pass polish is a separate control.
blocks.zh: 我们每张纸有两颗种子 并记录最多选择的QQ {1,8,64,512} {in {1,8,64,512} 代理评价。 适应性搜索可以及早停止,因此政策不需要使用同样数量的评价. 所选文本称为终点. 在64和512时,相同的主语义检查器判断每个非空端点作为完整的文件,使用上面的保存标准;失败的结束点贡献零收益. 一点和八点的终点缺乏最后的检查,而且是探索性的。 被过滤的单路抛光器是一个单独的控制器.

blocks.zh: 2.5 对 如何衡量协议和搜索收益?

blocks.en: For search, the comparison is adaptive gain minus random gain. We compute this difference for each seed, average the two seeds within a paper, then average the papers. Invalid or unedited choices contribute zero gain, so a failed check never removes a paper from the comparison.
blocks.zh: 对于搜索,比较是适应收益减去随机收益. 我们计算每个种子的这个差异,平均在一张纸里的两个种子,然后平均纸. 无效或未经编辑的选择贡献了零增益,所以一个失败的检查永远不会从比较中移除一个纸张.

blocks.en: To compare score changes, we divide by each evaluator’s sample standard deviation (SD) across the 328 original papers, the 200 Study 2 and 128 Study 3 originals combined. A change of one SD is as large as that evaluator’s typical between-paper variation, not a measure of scientific quality; it equals 0.153, 0.227, and 0.273 in acceptance score for S S , T 1 T_{1} , and T 2 T_{2} . We also give absolute changes in points, 100 times the raw acceptance score (Supplementary Section S1.4 ).
blocks.zh: 为了比较分数变化,我们用每个评价员的样本标准差(SD)来划分328份原始论文,200份研究2和128份研究3原件。 一个自毁的改变与评估员典型的纸张间变异(而不是科学质量的衡量标准)一样大;它等于0.153,0.227,在S S,T 1 T_{1}和T 2 T_{2}的接受分数中为0.273。 我们还在点数上给出绝对变化,为原始接受分数的100倍(补充部分S1.4.

blocks.en: We use 10,000 paper-level percentile bootstrap ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1993 ) resamples for the principal means, keeping edits and search seeds within paper. For each target, we test two outcomes: agreement on individual edits and adaptive-minus-random search gain at Q = 512 Q=512 . These make four pre-specified tests (Table 4 ), run with the bfloat16 implementation. Holm’s procedure at 0.05 ( Holm, 1979 ) adjusts only these four two-sided bootstrap tail probabilities, controlling the chance of any false positive in that family.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一万张纸层百分位靴子(Efron和Tibshirani,1993年), 对于每个目标,我们测试两种结果:在Q=512 QQ512中,就单个编辑和适应-减随机搜索收益达成一致. 这些测试有4项预先规定的测试(表4),与bfloat16的执行同时进行。 Holm在0.05(Holm,1979年)的程序只调整了这四个双侧的靴子尾部概率,控制了该家族出现任何假阳性的可能性.

blocks.en: Because the bfloat16 edit changes are largely rounding error (Section 4.1 ), interpretation of the released weights uses the post hoc 32-bit rows of Table 4 . These rows are outside the four-test family.
blocks.zh: 由于bfloat16编辑修改主要是四舍五入的错误(第4.1节),对释放的权重的解释使用表4的后32位行. 这些行在四试家外.

blocks.en: Displayed 95% confidence intervals (CIs) are nominal bootstrap intervals for individual estimates. They are not simultaneous intervals and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Guidance on significance testing and statistical power informs our interpretation ( Dror et al., 2018 ; Card et al., 2020 ) . A result compatible with zero is not treated as evidence of equivalence.
blocks.zh: 显示95%的置信间隔(CIs)是单个估计的标称的靴子间隔. 它们不是同时间隔的,不作多次比较的调整。 关于意义测试和统计力量的指导意见为我们的解释提供了依据(Dror等人,2018年;Card等人,2020年)。 与零相容的结果不作为等效的证据。

blocks.en: Post hoc analyses, including the T 1 T_{1} – T 2 T_{2} comparison with Equation 1 , are outside the four-test family (Supplementary Section S6 ).
blocks.zh: 后期分析,包括T1 T_{1}–T2 T_{2}与方程式1的比较,在四试家族之外(补充部分S6).

blocks.en: 3 How often are the proposed edits valid?
blocks.zh: 3个 拟议编辑是否有效?

blocks.en: Preserving numbers does not ensure unchanged claims. None of the 28 whole-paper rewrites generated in the pilot, under two prompt formats, passed the checks: failures changed hedges, novelty qualifications, or intended versus completed achievements. We therefore check paragraph edits and polish paragraph by paragraph.
blocks.zh: 保留号不能确保索赔不变。 试运行过程中产生的28个整纸重写,在两种即时格式下,都没有通过检查:失败改变套期,新颖的资质,或计划相对于完成的成绩. 因此,我们逐段检查段落编辑和修改。

blocks.en: Passing the automated checks is only the first test of preservation (Supplementary Figure S2 a). The two checks admit 70.5% of checkable Study 2 paragraph edits but only 102 of 198 evidence removals, because the semantic checker rejects deletions that remove more than the named result or leave the paper incoherent. A second provider agrees with the primary checker on 86.6% of 1,323 rechecked items, a measure of consistency rather than correctness. Supplementary Section S3 gives the other pass rates, including those of search endpoints, and a planted-corruption challenge; no check estimates the miss rate for natural edits.
blocks.zh: 通过自动检查只是第一次保存测试(补充图S2a). 两次检查都接受70.5%的可校验研究2段编辑,但在198个证据清除中只有102个,因为语义检查器拒绝删除的删除内容超过命名结果或留下纸张不一致之处. 第二家供应商同意1 323个重新检查项目中86.6%的主要检查者的意见,这是一致性而不是正确性的尺度。 补充科 S3给出了其他的通过率,包括搜索端点的通过率,以及植入的腐败挑战;没有检查估计自然编辑的误差率.

blocks.en: The blind audit asks whether items already admitted by the checks are valid on human inspection. One author judges 99 items while blind to evaluator scores, checker verdicts, and search policy: 59 endpoints, 20 Study 2 presentation edits, and 20 evidence removals. The endpoint sample contains one endpoint per selected paper; Supplementary Section S3 describes the sampling and judgment procedure. All 59 endpoints and 20 presentation edits are judged valid. Exact one-sided 95% upper bounds on invalidity are 4.95% and 13.9%, respectively. The endpoint bound pools the search policies (counts by policy in Supplementary Table S3 ).
blocks.zh: 盲目审计询问检查中已经承认的物品在人检查时是否有效. 一位作者在对评价员的分数、核对员的判决和搜索政策视而不见的同时,对99个项目进行了评判:59个终点,20个研究2演示编辑,20个证据删除。 端点样本包含每份选定的论文一个端点;补充部分S3描述了采样和判断程序. 所有59个端点和20个演示文稿编辑都被认为有效. 残废率95%的单面上限分别为4.95%和13.9%。 端点约束搜索政策(补充表S3按政策计算)。

blocks.en: The audit judges six of 20 removals invalid: 30.0%, with a two-sided exact 95% CI of 11.9–54.3%. All six leave a coherence problem, such as a dangling connective, an experiment count that no longer fits, or an empty heading. Two also remove more than one result. The admitted removal intervention therefore mixes missing evidence with unintended coherence changes. We interpret it as removal performed by this editing procedure, rather than as a clean ablation of scientific evidence.
blocks.zh: 审计判断20次清除中有6次无效:30.0%,双侧准确的95%CI为11.9-54.3%. 所有六个都留下了一致性问题,比如一个疏松的连接,一个不再适合的实验计数,或者一个空头. 二也除去不止一个结果. 因此,被接受的清除措施将缺失的证据与意外的连贯性变化混为一谈。 我们把它解释为通过这种编辑程序进行的删除,而不是对科学证据的清理。

blocks.en: The audit does not filter the primary analysis. The audit has one rater, who is an author; there is no independent inter-rater reliability estimate. Undetected content changes could raise or lower agreement, depending on how they reorder each scorer’s responses, and the audit cannot tell which.
blocks.zh: 审计没有过滤初级分析。 审计有一个评分员,他是作者;没有独立的评分间可靠性估计. 未发现的内容变化可以引起或降低协议,这取决于它们如何重新排列每个记分员的答复,审计无法分辨哪个.

blocks.en: A separate task examines disagreements between checkers. The same author judges 30 items accepted by the primary checker but rejected by the second provider: 13 are invalid and one is uncertain. One item overlaps with the blind audit, leaving 29 additional items. These selected disagreements show real checker misses, but cannot estimate errors shared by both checkers. Supplementary Section S3 gives the audit overlap, review procedure, failure categories, and overlap with the invariant check. The primary analysis remains unchanged; passing the automated checks is not a guarantee of content preservation.
blocks.zh: 一项单独的任务审查棋盘之间的分歧。 同一位作者判定30件物品被初选者接受,但被第二个提供者拒绝:13件无效,1件不确定。 一个项目与盲目审计重叠,另外还有29个项目。 这些选中的分歧显示真实的检查器丢失, 但无法估计两个检查器共享的错误 。 补充科 S3给出了审计的重叠,审查程序,失败类别,以及与无变化检查的重叠. 主要分析保持不变;通过自动化检查并不能保证内容保存。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pre-specified edit-fidelity and search tests. Edit fidelity is the mean within-paper Spearman correlation ( Spearman, 1904 ) ; the search contrast is adaptive minus random target gain at a maximum budget of 512 surrogate evaluations, in target standard deviation (SD) units, with both policies selecting by the surrogate. Confidence intervals (CIs) are nominal 95% paper-bootstrap intervals; p p -values are Holm-adjusted across the four pre-specified rows ( Holm, 1979 ) , which use the bfloat16 implementation (Section 2 ). The rows after the four pre-specified tests are post hoc, descriptive, uncorrected for multiplicity, and outside the testing family: the edit-fidelity estimand applied to the two targets, and edit fidelity, search contrast, and target agreement with the targets rescored in 32-bit floating point.
blocks.zh: 表4:预指定的编辑可靠性和搜索测试. 编辑忠诚度是纸内斯皮尔曼相关(Spearman,1904年)的平均值;搜索对比是适应性-随机目标增益,最高预算为512代位评价,属于目标标准偏差(SD)单位,两者政策均由代位选择. 置信间隔(CIs)是名义上的95%的纸-布图间隔;p-值是Holm调整的,跨越4个预先指定的行(Holm,1979年),使用bfloat16执行(第2节)。 四个预先指定的测试后的行是后期的,描述性的,对多重性的没有修正的,在测试家族之外:编辑的-真实性 estimity 应用到两个目标上,并编辑忠心,搜索对比,以及目标与目标在32位浮点中重排的协议.

blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Original-paper agreement is not detected on edits
blocks.zh: 4.1 编辑时未发现原始文件协议

blocks.en: In the pre-specified bfloat16 analysis, the classifier shows no detectable edit-ranking agreement with either target. Across 198 papers with at least five admitted edits and varying scores, mean within-paper correlations are − 0.008 -0.008 for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.015 -0.015 for T 2 T_{2} (Table 4 ). Their nominal 95% upper limits are 0.025 and 0.022, leaving little support for positive mean agreement in this edit population. These bounds concern differences among edits within a paper, whereas original-paper correlations concern differences between whole papers. Section 4.3 therefore also measures the practical score gain from selecting edits.
blocks.zh: 在预先指定的bfloat16分析中,分类器显示没有可检测到的与任一目标的编辑级协议. 在至少有5份被认可编辑和得分不同的198份论文中,纸内的平均相关性为:T1 TQQ1}−0.008 - 0.008,T2 TXQ2}−0.015 - 0.015 (表4)。 其名义上95%的上限为0.025和0.022,使得在这个编辑人群中很少支持积极的平均协议. 这些界限涉及文件内编辑之间的差异,而原始文件的相关性则涉及整份文件之间的差异。 因此,第4.3节还衡量选择编辑的实际得分收益。

blocks.en: On the 198 papers used here rather than the 1,667-paper benchmark, S S ’s rank correlation is 0.724 with T 1 T_{1} and 0.479 with T 2 T_{2} , so the paper-versus-edit contrast is not a cohort difference (Supplementary Section S4 ).
blocks.zh: 在此处使用的198份论文上,而不是1,667份纸质基准上,S S的排名相关性为0.724与T 1 T_{1}和0.479与T 2 T_{2},因此,纸张与编辑的对比不是组别差异(补充部分S4).

blocks.en: The null is not confined to the sparse classifier. A post hoc dense surrogate that reads word order also shows no edit agreement with the bfloat16 targets. Copies of S S trained with the same recipe on disjoint halves of its data agree only weakly with each other on edits. A regularized linear predictor fitted to target changes finds no agreement on held-out papers, but also recovers S S ’s own changes poorly, limiting that check. Supplementary Section S6.5 gives these models and estimates.
blocks.zh: 无效者不仅限于少数分类者。 一个读取单词顺序的后置密集代词也显示没有与 bfloat16 对象的编辑协议. 在编辑方面彼此意见不一致。 配有目标变化的正规线性预测器发现对搁置的纸张没有达成一致意见,但也收回了S S本身的变动不佳,限制了检查。 S6.5补充部分提供了这些模型和估计数。

blocks.en: The targets themselves agree weakly on edits despite agreeing on original papers. On the same 198 papers, their original-paper correlation is 0.603, while their post hoc 32-bit edit agreement is 0.047 ​ [ 0.004 , 0.090 ] 0.047\;[0.004,\,0.090] (Table 4 ; Figure 2 c). They share an architecture and base checkpoint but differ in training collection and prompt. Swapping T 1 T_{1} ’s prompt for T 2 T_{2} ’s changes its edit rankings much more than its paper rankings and does not close the target-agreement gap (Supplementary Section S6.4 ).

blocks.en: Numerical precision matters because the rewrites cause small score changes. At full precision, mean absolute responses over all 199 papers with admitted edits range from 1.0 to 1.4 raw-score points out of 100. The pre-specified bfloat16 implementation produces larger changes dominated by rounding, and its edit changes agree only weakly with the 32-bit ones (Supplementary Section S6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 数值精度很重要,因为重写会导致小分数变化. 完全精确地说,在接受编辑的所有199篇论文中,有1.0至1.4个原始分数的绝对答复。 预指定的bfloat16执行产生以四舍五入为主的较大变化,其编辑变化仅与32位变化弱同(补充部分S6.4 .

blocks.en: A hardware check separates this precision effect from reproducibility. Scoring in 32-bit on a second GPU reproduces edit changes almost exactly (0.9997 and 0.9998 on 25 papers; Supplementary Section S6.4 ). With 32-bit targets, the edit-fidelity estimates remain near zero (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 硬件检查将这种精度效应与可复制性区分开来. 在第二个GPU上以32位计的分数复制了几乎准确的编辑变化(在25篇论文上为0.9997和0.9998;补充部分S6.4. 有了32位目标,编辑真实性估计仍然接近零(表4 ).

blocks.en: A whitespace-only control measures sensitivity to a change that leaves the wording intact. On a matched 60-paper subset, adding a space moves the 32-bit target scores about half as much as an ordinary rewrite (Supplementary Section S6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 仅限空白的控制措施对保留措辞不变的更改的敏感性。 在匹配的60纸子集上,添加一个空间移动32位目标得分大约相当于普通重写的一半(补充部分S6.4 ).

blocks.en: To test whether this sensitivity disrupts edit rankings, we rescore the rewrites from a seeded 60-paper subset after adding one space between two sentences away from the edited span. For each target, we correlate its edit-score changes before and after adding the space. The mean within-paper correlations are 0.760 ​ [ 0.713 , 0.804 ] 0.760\;[0.713,\,0.804] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.743 ​ [ 0.692 , 0.783 ] 0.743\;[0.692,\,0.783] for T 2 T_{2} in 32-bit.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这种灵敏度是否干扰编辑排行,我们从一个播种的60纸子集中重新计分,然后在两个句子之间添加一个空间,远离编辑的跨度。 对于每个目标,我们在添加空间之前和之后将它的编辑分数变化联系起来。 纸内平均相关性为0.760 [0.713,0.804] 0.760\;[0.713,\,0.804]为T1 T_{1}和0.743 [0.692,0.783] 0.743\;[0.692,\,0.783]为T2 T_{2}以32位表示.

blocks.en: These rankings are fairly stable under this one perturbation, but stability does not establish sensitivity to scientific content. Other perturbations could reveal lower reliability. Supplementary Section S6.4 gives the conditional attenuation comparison.
blocks.zh: 在这种扰动下,这些排名相当稳定,但稳定性并不能确立对科学内容的敏感性. 其他干扰可能显示可靠性较低。 补充部分S6.4提供了有条件的减值比较。

blocks.en: The narrow agreement bound covers the full eligible edit set. To check the subset that moves a target more than the whitespace control, we retain responses above each target’s own control-response 95th percentile: agreement with S S is 0.050 ​ [ − 0.068 , 0.166 ] 0.050\;[-0.068,\,0.166] for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.045 ​ [ − 0.166 , 0.078 ] -0.045\;[-0.166,\,0.078] for T 2 T_{2} (62 and 50 papers), so the study cannot bound agreement tightly on the edits the targets respond to most.
blocks.zh: 约束的狭义协议涵盖了完全合格的编辑集. 为了检查移动目标大于白空间控制的子集,我们保留了超过每个目标自身控制-响应95%的响应:与S S的协议是0.050 [− 0.068, 0.166] 0.050\; [− 0.068, \ 0. 166] 对于T 1 T_{1} 和 0.045 [− 0.166, 0.078] 对于 T 2 T_{2} (62 和 50 份文件) , 研究不能严格约束编辑对象的协议。

blocks.en: Evidence removal asks a different question: whether the targets distinguish lost results from a matched deletion of other text. The paired result-removal and sham deletions have no detectable difference in either target’s score, in bfloat16 or in 32-bit (93 papers; Supplementary Section S5 ). However, audited removals often damaged coherence (Section 3 ). The intervals also allow content responses as large as a mean edit response. This test therefore does not show that the targets ignore content.
blocks.zh: 删除证据提出了另一个问题:目标是否区分损失的结果与相应删除其他案文的结果。 成对的结果清除和假删除在目标得分、bfloat16或32位(93篇论文;补充部分S5 )方面没有可察觉的差别。 然而,经审计的清除量往往损害一致性(第3节)。 间隔时间还允许内容响应作为平均编辑响应的大小. 因此,这一测试并不表明目标忽略了内容.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Proxy choices give little average advantage in equal-size five-edit banks (post hoc). (a, b) Chosen target change minus the exact uniform-random mean of the same sampled bank, for surrogate choice, sibling choice, and the evaluated target’s oracle choice. Open markers denote proxy choices; filled markers denote the outcome-informed oracle. The intervals are conditional on the existing edit banks and exclude Monte Carlo subsampling error, which Supplementary Section S6 quantifies.

(a,b) 选定目标的变化减去同一抽样银行的确切统一随机平均值,用于替代选择、兄弟选择和被评估目标甲骨文选择。 开放标记表示代理选择;填充标记表示结果知情的预告. 估计平均有1 000份在198份论文中抽取;间隔为名义上的95%的纸-布网信任间隔。 目标变化是释放重量的32位重评,以每个目标在200个研究2原版中的32位标准差(SD)的单位表示;bfloat16值在补充表S11中. (c,d) 纸质甲骨文-减去-选择-遗憾的经验累积分布,平均于这些相同的图纸;固线使用代位,虚线,比兄弟. 间隔以现有的编辑库为条件,排除了蒙特卡洛子采样错误,补充部分S6对它进行了量化.

blocks.en: The cross-GPU check establishes reproducible rankings, but does the estimand register agreement between different scorers? In a bfloat16 positive control, graded paragraph deletions produce agreement across all three pairs; length-preserving word shuffles produce agreement only for S S – T 1 T_{1} . The controls damage progressively larger sets of paragraphs, with each severe version containing the milder damage. This gives an easier graded signal than equal-size edits (Supplementary Section S6.5 ).
blocks.zh: 交叉GPU检查建立可复制的排名,但不同计分者之间的意向和注册协议呢? 在bfloat16正控中,分级段落的删除产生所有三对协议;长度保留词shuffles只产生S – T 1 T_{1}的协议. 控制损害的几组段落逐渐增加,每个重版包含较轻的损害。 这比同等大小的编辑更方便分级信号(补充部分S6.5 ).

blocks.en: A further control removes the nesting as well as the length change. For each of 50 papers, we create ten versions, each scrambling a different single paragraph. The versions keep their length and are not nested. Using float16 as a proxy for the release recipe, the two targets agree at 0.226 ​ [ 0.128 , 0.316 ] 0.226\;[0.128,\,0.316] , whereas S S agrees with neither ( − 0.068 ​ [ − 0.144 , 0.010 ] -0.068\;[-0.144,\,0.010] and − 0.043 ​ [ − 0.141 , 0.057 ] -0.043\;[-0.141,\,0.057] ; Supplementary Section S6.5 ); the estimand thus registers agreement between the targets on equal-size changes, although no tested equal-size change set shows agreement between S S and a target.
blocks.zh: 进一步的控制可以移除巢穴以及长度变化. 每50篇论文,我们创造10个版本,每个版本拼写不同的单段. 版本保持长度,不筑巢. 使用浮点16作为发布食谱的代用,两个指标在0.226 [0.128, 0.316] 0.226\;[0.128, \, 0.316] 同意,而S则同意两个指标(0.068 [−0.144, 0.010] - 0.068\;[-0.144,\, 0.010] 和 0.043 [−0.141, 0.057] - 0.043\;[-0.141,\, 0.057];补充部分S6.5]) ;因此,Estim和登记目标之间关于同等大小的改变的协议,尽管没有经过测试的等大小改变设定显示S和一个目标之间的协议。

blocks.en: 4.2 Adaptive search raises the surrogate little and the targets not detectably
blocks.zh: 4.2 适应性搜索使替代物很少,目标无法探测

blocks.en: At the pre-specified maximum budget of 512, adaptive search does not measurably outperform random search on either target, in bfloat16 or in 32-bit (Table 4 ); other budgets are exploratory (Supplementary Figure S5 ). The search barely raises its own objective: at 512, its mean increase over the unedited paper is 0.064 surrogate SD, versus 0.053 for random search, a difference of 0.011 ​ [ 0.008 , 0.013 ] 0.011\;[0.008,\,0.013] SD. A target gain of that size lies inside both bfloat16 intervals. In 32-bit, however, it exceeds both upper limits (0.0015 and 0.0089 SD). Thus, a gain as large as the surrogate’s is excluded on each target’s own SD scale; equal SD units need not mean equal transfer. Neither policy’s target gain over the original excludes zero (Supplementary Table S7 ); twelve adaptive and ten random endpoints fail the final semantic-preservation check and remain in the analysis with zero gain.
blocks.zh: 在预先指定的最高预算512中,适应性搜索在bfloat16或32位中不会比任意搜索更出色(表4);其他预算是探索性的(补充图S5)。 搜索勉强提升了自己的目标:在512时,其比未经编辑的论文的平均增量为0.064代用SD,相对于随机搜索的0.053,差额为0.011[0.008,0.013]0.011\;[0.008,\,0.013]SD. 这种大小的目标增益 存在于两个bfloat16间隔。 然而在32位中,它超过了两个上限(0.0015和0.0089 SD). 因此,在每个目标本身的自毁规模中不包括与代孕者相同的收益;平等的自毁单位不一定意味着平等的转移。 两个政策的目标收益均不包括零(补充表S7),12个适应性终点和10个随机终点未能完成最后的语义保护检查,在分析中保留零收益。

blocks.en: 4.3 Fixed-size edit banks reveal little proxy-selection advantage
blocks.zh: 4.3 固定规模编辑库显示很少具有代理选择优势

blocks.en: This post hoc check compares choices from the same five-edit bank against its average target gain, the expected result of uniform random choice. The sibling chooser is T 2 T_{2} when evaluating T 1 T_{1} , and conversely. Choosing with the evaluated target supplies an outcome-informed oracle, which requires target access.
blocks.zh: 这个后特设检查将同一五版银行的选择与其平均目标收益,即统一随机选择的预期结果进行比较. 兄弟姐妹选择者是T2 TQQQ2}当评估T1 TQQ1},反之亦然。 与被评价的目标进行选择可提供成果信息预言,这需要目标进入。

blocks.en: Neither S S nor the sibling model shows a measurable average advantage over random choice (Figure 3 a, b). By contrast, choosing with the evaluated target gives advantages of 0.076 ​ [ 0.071 , 0.082 ] 0.076\;[0.071,\,0.082] SD for T 1 T_{1} and 0.052 ​ [ 0.047 , 0.058 ] 0.052\;[0.047,\,0.058] for T 2 T_{2} . These are 1.8 and 1.3 raw-score points, more than twice the mean change from an added space. Surrogate and sibling choices stay within 0.005 SD of random choice. This positive advantage follows from selecting the highest target score; it measures available score variation, not semantic improvement. The bfloat16 estimates are in Supplementary Table S11 .
blocks.zh: 无论是SS还是Sible模型都没有显示比随机选择有可衡量的平均优势(图3a,b). 相比之下,与被评价的目标相比,选择优于0.076 [0.071, 0.082] 0.076\; [0.071,\, 0.082] SD为T 1 T_{1}和0.052 [0.047, 0.058] 0.052\; [0.047,\, 0.058]为T 2 T_{2}. 这些是1.8和1.3的原始积分,是新增空间的两倍多的平均值变化。 代理和兄弟选择在零零五SD范围内 随机选择 这一积极优势来自于选择最高目标分数;它衡量现有的分数变化,而不是语义上的改进. bfloat16估计数载于补充表S11。

blocks.en: Larger candidate sets increase the oracle’s advantage, but not the proxies’ measurable advantage, on a fixed cohort (Supplementary Figure S7 ). The finding concerns small presentation-level responses; it does not show that edit preferences diverge where responses are large.
blocks.zh: 较大的候选人组合增加了神谕在固定组别上的优势,而不是代理人的可衡量优势(补充图S7)。 调查结果涉及小的列报层面的答复;它没有显示编辑偏好在答复大的地方有差异。

blocks.en: 5 Related work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Predicting acceptance from paper text predates large language models: PeerRead paired submissions with their decisions and trained acceptance classifiers on the text ( Kang et al., 2018 ) . Natural language processing (NLP) work on peer review spans generated reviews ( Yuan et al., 2022 ) , shared datasets, and assistance tasks ( Dycke et al., 2023 ; Kuznetsov et al., 2024 ) . LLM feedback on research papers overlaps substantially with points raised by human reviewers ( Liang et al., 2024 ) , while evaluations of LLM reviewers report clear limits in scoring and critique ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ) . IteraTeR annotates iterative edits and their intentions across several domains ( Du et al., 2022 ) ; arXivEdits aligns scientific paper versions and annotates edit intentions ( Jiang et al., 2022 ) . ARIES links paper edits to reviewer comments ( D’Arcy et al., 2024 ) . These resources mix content and presentation changes and do not cover the held-out ICLR 2026 papers, so we use checked synthetic rewrites.
blocks.zh: 从纸质文本中预测接受时间早于大语言模型: PeerRead将提交材料与其决定和经过培训的接受分类者在文本上配对(Kang等人,2018年). 自然语言处理(NLP)关于同行评审的工作跨度产生评审(Yuan等人,2022年),共享数据集和援助任务(Dycke等人,2023年;Kuznetsov等人,2024年). 对研究论文的LLM反馈与人文审查员提出的点数(Liang等人,2024年)大相径庭,而LLM审查员的评价则报告在评分和批评方面有明确的限制(Zhou等人,2024年;Du等人,2024年)。 IteraTeR将迭代编辑及其意图贯穿多个领域(Du等人,2022年);arXivEdits将科学论文版本与注释编辑意图相协调(Jiang等人,2022年). ARIES将文件编辑与评论者的评论联系起来(D ' Arcy等人,2024年)。 这些资源混合了内容和演示文稿的修改,不涵盖被搁置的ICLR 2026论文,因此我们使用检查过的合成重写.

blocks.en: Table 5 distinguishes the closest comparisons from our question. PaperScorer’s feature baseline reports 61.1% accuracy, a different metric from our AUC. Its section-edit gains of 3.9–6.1% also differ in unit from our raw-score points. We did not rerun those revisions or assess the size or validity of its gains. Supplementary Section S6.5 compares the between-paper and within-paper estimands.
blocks.zh: 表5将最接近的比较与我们的问题区分开来。 校对:Soup 其分节编辑收益3.9-6.1%的单位也不同于我们的原始分数。 我们没有重审这些修订,也没有评估其成果的规模或有效性。 第S6.5节补充部分比较了文件与文件内部的说明。

blocks.en: Table 5: The closest comparisons address different questions and units of analysis.
blocks.zh: 表5:最接近的比较涉及不同的问题和分析单位。

blocks.en: Substitute models can generate adversarial inputs that transfer to a target whose internals are unknown ( Papernot et al., 2017 ; Demontis et al., 2019 ) , including word-level attacks on text classifiers ( Jin et al., 2020 ) . Transfer depends partly on how well the two models’ input gradients align ( Demontis et al., 2019 ) . Our edit-fidelity measure compares responses to a discrete set of edits. Interpretability uses surrogates to explain individual predictions ( Ribeiro et al., 2016 ) , and model extraction asks how far a substitute reproduces a target’s outputs ( Tramèr et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 替代模型可以产生对抗性输入,向内部未知的目标转移(Papernot等人,2017年;Demontis等人,2019年),包括对文本分类器的字位攻击. (Jin等人,2020年). 转移部分取决于两个模型的输入梯度是否一致(Demontis等人,2019年)。 我们的编辑-忠诚度量比对了一组独立的编辑。 可解释性使用代词来解释个人的预测(Ribeiro等人,2016年),模型提取则询问代词复制目标输出的距离(Tramèr等人,2016年).

blocks.en: Other attacks manipulate the scored input directly. Distracting sentences and input-agnostic trigger sequences alter NLP outputs ( Jia and Liang, 2017 ; Wallace et al., 2019 ) ; TextAttack provides standardized search methods for such perturbations ( Morris et al., 2020 ) . Optimizing a learned proxy can raise its score while the objective it stands for stalls or declines ( Gao et al., 2023 ) , a failure formalized as reward hacking ( Skalse et al., 2022 ) and classified under Goodhart’s law ( Manheim and Garrabrant, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 其他攻击直接操纵得分输入. 分散句子和输入-不可知触发序列改变NLP输出(Jia and Liang, 2017;Wallace等人, 2019;TextAttack)为这种扰动提供了标准化的搜索方法(Morris等人, 2020). 优化一个博学的代理可以提高它的分数,而它代表的是摊位或下降的目标(Gao等人,2023年),失败被正式定为奖励黑客(Skalse等人,2022年),并被归类为古德哈特定律(Manheim and Garrabrant, 2018年).

blocks.en: In peer review, repackaging raises review scores and can transfer to unqueried reviewers ( Yang et al., 2026a ) ; abstract rephrasing also transfers without knowing the reviewing model ( Li et al., 2026b ) . PaperGuard studies surrogate-based attacks on multimodal review ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Prompt injection instead embeds explicit instructions in papers ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , unlike our paragraph rewrites. Earlier surrogate-based modifications targeted unknown paper–reviewer assignment systems ( Eisenhofer et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 在同行评审中,重新包装会提高评审分数,并可以转会给未结的评审员(Yang等人,2026a;抽象重排也会在不知道评审模式的情况下转会(Li等人,2026b)). PaperGuard研究了对多式联运审查的基于替代攻击(赵等人,2026年). 迅速注射反而将明确的指示嵌入文件(周等人,2026年)中,不同于我们的段落重写. 早先的替代修改针对未知的纸张-审查者指派系统(Eisenhofer等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Predictive accuracy and response to optimization are distinct. Equally accurate classifiers can conflict on individual predictions ( Marx et al., 2020 ) , and transfer attacks can exploit shared adversarial directions and nearby decision boundaries ( Tramèr et al., 2017 ) . Reward models with similar in-distribution accuracy can diverge once a policy is optimized against them; ensembling reduces overoptimization ( Coste et al., 2024 ; Eisenstein et al., 2024 ) but does not remove reward hacking ( Eisenstein et al., 2024 ) . Essays written to exploit an automated scorer can receive scores unlike human raters’ ( Powers et al., 2002 ) , and short-answer scorers can be fooled by answers with shuffled words ( Ding et al., 2020 ) . Our result measures this known gap for released acceptance predictors on checker-admitted paragraph rewrites; the contribution is the measurement, not the phenomenon. Here transfer means that edits selected with one scorer also raise another scorer’s output.
blocks.zh: 预测准确性和对优化的反应是不同的。 同样准确的分类器可能与个人预测相冲突(Marx等人,2020年),转移攻击可以利用共同的对抗方向和附近的决定界限(Tramèr等人,2017年). 具有类似分配精度的奖励模式,一旦对政策进行优化,就会出现差异;综艺减少过度优化(Coste等人,2024年;Eisenstein等人,2024年),但不会消除奖励黑客(Eisenstein等人,2024年)。 为了利用自动计分器而撰写的论文可以获得与人类计分器不同的分数(Powers et al., 2002),短答计分器可以用洗牌词的回答来愚弄(Ding et al., 2020). 我们的结果衡量了这一已知的空白,即检查器所允许的段落重写时所释放的接受预测器;贡献在于测量,而不是现象。 这里的传输意味着使用一个计分器选择的编辑也会提高另一个计分器的输出.

blocks.en: Counterfactual evaluation probes whether automatic reviewers detect faulty research logic ( Dycke and Gurevych, 2026 ) . Controlled rhetorical rewrites reveal structured changes in review judgments ( Li et al., 2026c ) , while RobustReview treats stability under preserving rewrites and discrimination across papers as a joint requirement (Table 5 ). We compare response magnitudes and edit-level agreement, rather than proposing a robust reviewer. Testing models on minimally edited inputs, rather than only on held-out accuracy, follows behavioral testing and contrast sets ( Ribeiro et al., 2020 ; Gardner et al., 2020 ) ; counterfactually augmented data also use revised examples for training ( Kaushik et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 反事实评价探究自动审查员是否检测出错误的研究逻辑(Dycke and Gurevich, 2026). 受控制的修辞重写揭示了审查判决的结构性变化(Li等人,2026c),而《有力审查》则把在保留重写和对论文的歧视下的稳定视为一项共同要求(表5)。 我们比较反应的程度和编辑一级的协议,而不是提议一个强有力的审查员。 对经过最低限度编辑的投入进行测试的模型,而不是仅对搁置的准确性进行测试,遵循行为测试和对照(Ribeiro等人,2020年;Gardner等人,2020年);反事实扩充的数据也使用修订的例子进行培训(Kaushik等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: LLM evaluators can correlate with human ratings ( Liu et al., 2023 ) yet shift judgments with candidate order ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Koo et al., 2024 ) , familiar text or small prompt changes ( Stureborg et al., 2024 ) , and their own generations ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM评价员可以和人类评分(Liu等人,2023年)相关联,但根据候选顺序(Wang等人,2024年;Koo等人,2024年),熟悉的文字或小的即时变化(Stureborg等人,2024年),以及他们自己的几代人做出转变判断. (Panickssery等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Evaluating revisions also requires knowing what changed. This is needed to check whether a revision addresses a reviewer’s concern ( Li et al., 2026a ) or to separate style from content ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) . Our preservation checks serve this role, and their errors limit the agreement measurement.
blocks.zh: 评价修订工作还需要了解所发生的变化。 这是为了检查修订是否解决了审查者的关切(Li等人,2026a),还是将风格与内容区分开来(Quu等人,2025年)。 我们的保全检查起到了这种作用,其错误限制了协议的衡量。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 What original-paper agreement leaves unmeasured
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 原始协议留下的未计量

blocks.en: The surrogate and the two acceptance models agree more on existing papers than on revisions. The surrogate closely tracks the first target’s original-paper rankings, yet barely tracks which rewrites raise its score. The two targets also share some response to edits, but their agreement is weak. This distinction matters whenever one scorer stands in for another during revision selection.
blocks.zh: 代办和两个验收模式更同意现有文件而非修改. 取代者密切跟踪第一目标原始纸质排名, 这两个目标也有一些对编辑的回应,但他们的一致意见很弱. 这种区别对于在审校选择期间一个记分员代表另一个记分员的情况至关重要。

blocks.en: Paper prediction and edit response can depend on different textual properties. Our checks hold most document-structure counts fixed, so the edit comparison mainly probes word features and length. Those word features also carry much of the surrogate’s original-paper agreement with the first target; holding structure fixed alone therefore does not explain that pair’s gap. For the second target, original-paper agreement depends more on structure, making it a weaker premise for revision selection. Supplementary Section S6.5 gives these feature comparisons and a geometric description of the directions the edits change. They motivate possible accounts, rather than establish a mechanism.
blocks.zh: 纸质预测和编辑响应可以取决于不同的文字属性. 我们的检查使大多数文档结构计数被固定,所以编辑比较主要探究文字特征和长度. 这些单词特征也包含着替代人与第一个目标的原始文件协议中的大部分内容;因此,仅持有固定结构并不能解释该对的空白。 对于第二个目标,原始文件协议更多地依赖于结构,使它成为修改选择的较弱前提. 补充部分S6.5给出了这些特征比较和编辑改变方向的几何描述. 它们激发了可能的核算,而不是建立一个机制。

blocks.en: Acceptance labels are noisy ( Cortes and Lawrence, 2021 ; Beygelzimer et al., 2023 ) . They report paper-level decisions, rather than preferences among presentation rewrites. Copies of the surrogate trained on disjoint halves of its data give different edit rankings, consistent with such preferences being weakly constrained by those labels. Yet the targets share some response magnitudes after accounting for edit size, position, and type, and they agree on rankings of equal-size paragraph scrambles. Thus these change sets contain shared signal, even though the surrogate does not capture the targets’ edit rankings. Input sensitivity could still dominate the targets’ responses; the analyses do not identify a causal mechanism inside either model.
blocks.zh: 接受标签很吵(Cortes and Lawrence, 2021;Beygelzimer等人, 2023). 它们报告的是纸面决定,而不是重写列报中的偏好。 对其数据进行断开连接培训的代孕者的副本给出了不同的编辑排名,这与这种偏好受到这些标签的薄弱限制是一致的。 然而,目标在考虑编辑大小、位置和类型之后,分享了一些响应量,并商定相同大小段落的顺序。 因此,这些更改集包含共享的信号,即使代词不能捕捉目标的编辑排名. 投入敏感性仍可主导目标的反应;分析没有确定两个模式中的因果关系。

blocks.en: Different input lengths remain a limit. Every admitted changed paragraph is fully visible to both targets, while some extend beyond the surrogate’s shorter word window. Restricting the analysis to paragraphs visible to all scorers leaves agreement near zero (Supplementary Table S8 and Figure S4 ). This still leaves different surrounding text and whole-document features, and a length change can shift a target’s truncation boundary.
blocks.zh: 不同的输入长度仍然是一个限制. 每个被接受的修改段落对两个目标来说都是完全可见的,而有些则超出了替代者的较短的字眼。 将分析限制在所有记分员可见的段落后,协议接近于零(补充表S8和图S4)。 这仍然留下了不同的周围文字和整文档特征,长度变化可以改变目标截断边界.

blocks.en: 6.2 Scope and limitations
blocks.zh: 6.2 范围和限制

blocks.en: The surrogate scenario motivates the measurement but is not a documented practice, and the recommendation covers checker-admitted presentation-only paragraph rewrites, not content-bearing or section-level revisions. The evidence covers one sparse surrogate, a post hoc dense surrogate, one writer configuration, English ICLR papers, and two acceptance predictors trained from the same base language model.
blocks.zh: 代用假想激励了测量,但并不是一种有文件记载的做法,建议包括检查员允许的列报方式只重写段落,而不是内容或节级的修订。 证据包括一个稀疏的代词,一个特设密集代词,一个写作配置,英语ICLR论文,以及两个从同一个基语言模型训练的接受预测器.

blocks.en: We also test DeepReviewer-14B, a generative reviewer from another model family ( WestlakeNLP, 2025 ) . The score comes from one forced rating in an 8-bit version whose outputs were not validated against the original weights. It shows no edit-ranking agreement with the surrogate or either target, but also fails the equal-size scramble control. This check therefore cannot establish that the main null extends to other model families (Supplementary Section S7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们还测试DeepReviewer-14B,来自另一个模范家族的基因审查者(WestlakeNLP,2025年). 得分来自8位版本中的一个强制评级,其输出没有根据原始加权进行验证. 它没有显示与代理对象或任一目标之间的编辑级协议,但也失败了等大小的拼接控制. 因此,这一检查不能确定主要无效延伸至其他模范家庭(补充部分S7)。

blocks.en: Several extensions remain untested: other editors, content-changing and human revisions, and broader interventions. We also leave open nonlinear surrogates trained on edit outcomes or target scores, theory-derived rhetorical measures, such as signposting and reader address, and qualitative analysis of the largest responses. Model coverage does not include PaperScorer’s page-image and larger models, other generative and closed reviewers, or equalized model inputs. Earlier transfer results came from presentation-only revisions of the paper ( Yang et al., 2026a ) and adversarial rewrites of the abstract ( Li et al., 2026b ) , optimized against reviewers that read the same text; our checked paragraph edits and the surrogate’s different input could each reduce transfer.
blocks.zh: 几个扩展仍未经过测试:其他编辑、内容修改和人文修订以及更广泛的干预。 我们还保留接受过编辑结果或目标分数、理论衍生的修辞措施(如标语和读者地址)以及对最大答复的质量分析培训的开放式非线性代词。 模型覆盖范围不包括PaperScore的页面图像和更大的模型,其他基因审查和封闭审查,或等效模型输入. 更早的转移结果来自仅对论文(Yang等人,2026a)和对抽象(Li等人,2026b)的对抗性改写,对阅读相同文本的审核者进行了优化;我们所检查的段落编辑和替代者的不同输入可以减少转移。

blocks.en: Preservation is also uncertain. The single-author review of checker disagreements exposed missed content changes (Section 3 ). No human panel assessed paper quality or acceptance prospects, so score movement is not evidence of scientific merit; a planned human-reviewer comparison was dropped for lack of version-matched histories.
blocks.zh: 保护也是不确定的。 对核对器分歧的单一作者审查暴露了内容的误差(第3节)。 人类小组没有评估纸张质量或接受前景,因此评分运动不是科学价值的证据;由于缺乏版本匹配的历史,计划进行的人类-审查者比较被放弃.

blocks.en: The target scores themselves limit interpretation (Section 4.1 ). The release’s own recipe, which serves the weights in float16 through vLLM, was not run. A float16 pass in Transformers reproduces the 32-bit edit changes and benchmark AUCs and leaves edit fidelity near zero. In 32-bit, whitespace-only changes still move both targets in this implementation, which passes raw text. We did not check whether the release’s preprocessing normalizes whitespace. The design cannot tell whether the response reflects wording that the surrogates miss or sensitivity to formatting.
blocks.zh: 目标分数本身限制了解释(第4.1节)。 发行的食谱通过vLLM为浮点16的重量服务,没有运行. "变形金刚"中的浮点16通过,复制了32位的编辑变化和基准AUC,并使编辑忠贞度接近零. 在32位中,只有白空间的修改仍然会移动这个执行中的两个目标,它会传递原始文本. 我们没有检查发行预处理是否使白空间正常化 。 设计无法分辨该反应是否反映了代词对格式化的忽略或敏感的措辞.

blocks.en: The design was specified locally without public preregistration, the human audit followed scoring contrary to the earlier plan, and the post hoc analyses followed the four pre-specified tests.
blocks.zh: 设计是在没有公开预先登记的情况下在当地确定的,人的审计遵循了与先前计划相反的评分,事后分析遵循了四个预先指定的测试.

blocks.en: The practical consequence is to test revision tools on the changes they are meant to guide. The same checks could be applied to LLM judges and learned reward models when a cheaper scorer selects texts for another evaluator. Our study motivates those tests; it does not show that these other systems fail them.
blocks.zh: 其实际后果是测试修订工具旨在指导的变化。 当一个更便宜的计分员为另一名评价员选择文本时,同样的检查可以适用于LLM评委和学到的奖励模型. 我们的研究激励了这些测试;它没有显示这些其他系统未能实现。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In two released acceptance predictors, agreement on existing papers was not matched by detectable agreement on checked paragraph rewrites. The classifier tracks original-paper rankings closely for one target and moderately for the other, yet tracks neither’s edit rankings. The targets also barely agree on edits. Choosing edits with the classifier gives no detectable advantage over random choice. Even choosing the best of five with the predictor itself raises its score by under two points in 32-bit, more than twice the effect of an added space (Section 4.3 ). These results bound agreement for checker-admitted rewrites rather than show that either predictor is wrong. Revision tools should therefore be validated against their intended evaluators on the edits they select, with response reliability reported. Agreement between models does not establish valid edit preferences.
blocks.zh: 在两个公布的接受预测器中,关于现有文件的协议没有与关于经检查的段落改写的可探测协议相匹配。 分类者跟踪一个目标的原始纸排位和另一个目标的中度排位,但跟踪的不是编辑排位。 目标也在编辑上勉强达成一致. 用分类器选择编辑不会比随机选择有可察觉的优势. 即使选择最佳的5个,加上预测器本身,它的得分在32位中提高不到2分,是新增空间效果的两倍多(第4.3节). 这些结果约束协议用于检查器允许的重写,而不是显示任一预测器都是错误的. 因此,修订工具应在其选择的编辑中对照其预定评价人员进行验证,并报告答复的可靠性。 模型之间的协议没有确定有效的编辑偏好.

blocks.en: Broader impact statement
blocks.zh: 更广泛的影响说明

blocks.en: Automated paper scores can shape authors’ effort and research assessment. In this study, a cheap classifier’s agreement with acceptance predictors on existing papers did not indicate which revisions those predictors reward, and a constrained search that raised the classifier’s own score by about 0.06 SD did not detectably raise theirs. These observations support testing feedback tools on controlled revisions and not relying on their scores alone for publication decisions. Apart from this article and two licensed example paragraphs, the planned release contains no manuscript text, and it contains no author-facing submission optimizer.
blocks.zh: 自动纸评分可以影响作者的努力和研究评估。 在这项研究中,一个廉价的分类员与现有论文的接受预测员的协议没有说明这些预测员的奖励是哪些修订,而将分类员自己的得分提高约0.06 SD的限制性搜索也无法探测到他们的得分。 这些观察支持测试关于受控修改的反馈工具,而不是仅仅依靠其得分来做出出版决定. 除了这篇文章和两个特许的例子段落外,计划发行的版本没有手稿文本,也没有作者提交优化程序。

blocks.en: Data and code availability
blocks.zh: 数据和代码可用性

blocks.en: The experiments use the publicly released PaperScorer text dataset and checkpoints ( Konan et al., 2026c ) and the DeepReviewer-14B checkpoint ( WestlakeNLP, 2025 ) . The analysis code, paper identifiers, edit types and positions, scores, non-text metadata, and experiment logs are released at https://github.com/nbbllxx0/Ranking-Agreements , which is made public once the arXiv preprint of this article is available. Apart from the two licensed examples in Supplementary Section S2.6 , original and edited manuscript text will not be redistributed publicly; the frozen inputs, including the edited texts, are available to the editor and reviewers on request for verification only, under the terms of the source release. The released per-edit scores reproduce Table 4 and the agreement estimates without the texts; refitting models on the texts or computing text descriptors needs the frozen inputs. PaperScorer’s dataset and model cards state custom or “other” licensing, and the base models have their own terms; we do not treat them as freely redistributable. DeepReviewer use is subject to its model license and its prohibition on official peer reviewing and publication decisions.
blocks.zh: 实验使用公开发布的PaperScorer文本数据集和检查站(Konan等人,2026c)和DeepReviewer-14B检查站(WestlakeNLP,2025). 分析代码,纸质标识符,编辑类型和位置,分数,非文本元数据,以及实验日志在https://github.com/nbbllxx0/Ranking-Agreements上发布,一旦本文章的arXiv预印本可以公开. 除了补充部分S2.6中许可的两个例子外,原始和编辑的手稿文本不会公开再分发;根据原始资料发布的规定,冻结的投入,包括编辑文本,仅供编辑和审查人员索取核实。 发行的每版分数复制表4和协议估计,没有文本;在文本上重置模型或计算文本描述符需要冻结输入. 纸质计分器的数据集和型号卡都规定了惯例或“其他”许可证,而基本模式有自己的条件;我们不把它们视为可自由再分配。 深度审查者的使用须遵守其示范许可证,并禁止官方同行审查和公布决定。

blocks.en: S1 Evaluator configuration and input handling
blocks.zh: S1 评价器配置和输入处理

blocks.en: The lexical vocabulary contains at most 300,000 features, using word unigrams and bigrams with minimum document frequency three and sublinear term frequency. Vocabulary fitting uses training papers only. Structural features are log character count, figure-marker count, table count, displayed-equation count, heading count, citation-pattern count, title character count, and abstract character count. They are standardized using training-set means and variances. A GitHub-link indicator present in the initial feature inventory is removed before fitting the selected surrogate.
blocks.zh: 词典词汇包含最多30万个特征,使用单词unigrams和bigrams,最小文档频率为3和亚线性术语频率. 词汇装配只使用培训文件。 结构特征是日志字符计数,数字标记计数,表格计数,显示方程式计数,标题计数,引用-模式计数,标题字符计数,以及抽象字符计数. 采用培训手段和差异加以标准化。 初始特性目录中显示的 GitHub-link 指示器在安装选定代位之前被删除。

blocks.en: The structural block is multiplied by a weight chosen from { 0.05 , 0.1 , 0.3 } \{0.05,0.1,0.3\} . Logistic regression selects its inverse regularization strength from { 0.01 , 0.03 , 0.1 , 0.3 , 1 , 3 , 10 } \{0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1,3,10\} and runs at most 3,000 solver iterations. Validation AUC selects weight 0.3 and inverse regularization strength 1. The resulting validation AUC is 0.691. Training uses acceptance decisions rather than target-model scores. At inference, the abstract and structural features are recomputed for each edited document; lexical input is restricted to its first 30,000 characters. There is no online fitting during search.

blocks.en: The original-paper comparison contains 676 ICLR 2025 and 991 ICLR 2026 papers. Exact normalized-title matching finds 160 titles in T 2 T_{2} ’s arXiv training split: 62 from 2025 and 98 from 2026. Thus, T 2 T_{2} ’s full-benchmark AUC is context rather than a fully held-out estimate. The edit-study sampling separately excludes identified training families from both targets’ training corpora. This larger context benchmark is distinct from the 860-paper family-filtered source pool used for the editing studies. In the same-GPU sibling comparison, target AUCs on ICLR 2026 alone are 0.696 for T 1 T_{1} and 0.635 for T 2 T_{2} . The latter’s lower discrimination is another reason to avoid interpreting the two targets as interchangeable replications. A separate structure-only surrogate baseline reaches AUC 0.642; it is an ablation of our features, rather than an implementation of PaperScorer’s feature inventory.

blocks.en: S1.1 Editing-study sampling and target execution
blocks.zh: S1.1 编辑-研究抽样和目标执行

blocks.en: Editing candidates come only from the 991 ICLR 2026 test papers. We compare normalized titles and title-plus-abstract term frequency–inverse document frequency (TF–IDF) vectors with both released training corpora. Exact title matches and cosine similarity of at least 0.80 are excluded; similarity from 0.60 to below 0.80 is set aside. This leaves 860 candidates before excluding the 30 pilot papers and selecting the disjoint study samples. The filter concerns identified paper families, not base-model pretraining exposure.

blocks.en: Study 3 searches over admitted single-paragraph edits, allowing at most eight edits, one replacement per paragraph, and at most a 5% change relative to the original total character count. Both policies score candidates only with S S . Adaptive search evaluates compatible one-edit extensions in seeded random order and greedily accepts the best improving extension. It stops when no extension improves the current score, no feasible extension remains, or the evaluation allowance is exhausted. Random search samples feasible composites with an edit count drawn uniformly from one to eight, scores them with S S , and retains the highest-scoring candidate. blocks.en: S2 Editing and checking instructions

blocks.en: This section reproduces the shared scientific editing constraints and the task instructions. Each call supplies the complete anonymized source paper, divided into numbered paragraphs. The rules below are instructions to the experimental writer, rather than guarantees about its output; validity rates in Section 3 quantify compliance.
blocks.zh: 本节转载了共享的科学编辑约束和任务说明. 每个呼叫都提供完整的匿名源文件,分为数段. 下面的规则是给实验作者的指示,而不是对其输出的保证;第3节中的有效性率量化遵守.

blocks.en: S2.1 Shared writer rules
blocks.zh: S2.1 共同写作规则

blocks.en: Rules for every change (presentation only): 1. Keep every number, equation, citation, table, figure/table/section reference and heading exactly. 2. Claim strength is frozen: keep every hedge and intensifier exactly as written (for example: may, might, can, could, likely, suggests, aims to, attempts to, ensures, guarantees, significantly, substantially, highly, only, first, novel, unique, state-of-the-art, outperforms). Never turn an aim or attempt into an achievement, or the reverse. Never add or remove a statement that something is novel, first or unique. 3. Keep every factual statement and attribution; add or remove no results or evidence; do not move text between paragraphs. 4. You may change wording, sentence order within the paragraph, transitions, signposting and emphasis. 5. Keep the paper anonymous. The evidence-removal and sham tasks explicitly authorize their declared deletions; the remaining constraints apply outside the deleted spans.

blocks.en: S2.2 Atomic edits and deletions
blocks.zh: S2.2 原子编辑和删除

blocks.en: The bank-generation task is: Write 24 atomic presentation edits. Each edit replaces exactly one paragraph [Pn] (all pids distinct; skip headings, tables, equations, captions and reference lists) with a version that reads more convincingly to reviewers; give its kind (clarity, framing, structure, emphasis or flow). For Study 2, the task continues: Also define (a) an evidence removal: the paragraph ids that report exactly ONE experimental result supporting a claim stated in the abstract or introduction (quote that claim), removed by deleting those whole paragraphs and nothing else; (b) a sham: whole paragraphs from background or related work only, containing no results, no claim of this paper and no figure or table, whose total length is within 20% of the removal’s. The supplied output schema requires a paragraph number, replacement text, and edit type for each edit. Study 2 additionally requires the removal paragraph numbers and supporting claim, and the sham paragraph numbers. These are structured outputs; source manuscript text is not included in the planned public release.

blocks.en: S2.3 One-pass polishing
blocks.zh: S2.3 单路抛光

blocks.en: Polish the paper’s presentation in one pass, as a careful author would before submission. Return only the paragraphs you change, each with its pid and full new text; skip headings, tables, equations, captions and reference lists. The shared writer rules in Section S2.1 also apply. Each returned paragraph is checked separately, and only admitted replacements are composed into the scored polished version. This reduces content drift, while making the polishing intervention dependent on the checker as well as the writer.
blocks.zh: 作为一位谨慎的作者,在提交文件之前,将论文以一纸空文的形式发表。 只返回您更改的段落, 每个段落都有其pid和完整的新文本; 跳过标题、 表格、 方程式、 标题和参考列表 。 S2.1节中的共享写作规则也适用. 每个返回的段落都单独检查,只有被允许的替换才构成打分的抛光版本。 这可以减少内容漂移,同时使抛光干预依赖于检查器和编剧.

blocks.en: S2.4 Semantic check
blocks.zh: S2.4 语义检查

blocks.en: The checker sees the original paper plus the original and changed spans of every proposed item. Its shared instruction is: Check each ITEM. An edit is valid only if it is presentation-only: the same claims with the same strength and scope (no hedge or intensifier added, removed or changed; no aim turned into an achievement or the reverse; no novelty claim added or removed), the same numbers, citations and attributions, no added or removed evidence, nothing moved from other paragraphs. For deletions, the checker is additionally told that a removal must delete exactly one experimental result supporting the quoted claim and leave the paper coherent. A sham must remove only background or related work that is not evidence for the paper’s claims and contains no figure or table. For composite endpoints, the introductory instruction states that individually approved edits must be judged together as a whole. The second provider receives the same scientific checking task without the first checker’s verdicts or target scores.
blocks.zh: 检查者看到原件加上每个拟议项目的原件和更改的跨度。 其共同指示是:检查每个项目。 编辑只有在下述情况下才有效:同样具有同等强度和范围的债权(没有添加、删除或更改套期或强化符;没有将目标转化为成就或相反;没有添加或删除新的债权);相同的数字、引用和归属;没有添加或删除证据;没有从其他段落中挪动任何东西。 关于删除,还告诉检查员,删除必须删除一个支持所引述索赔的试验结果,并保持纸张的一致性。 假的必须只删除不是文件索赔证据、没有图表的背景或有关工作。 对于综合端点,介绍性说明指出,个别核准的编辑必须作为一个整体来判断。 第二家提供商接受同样的科学检查任务,而无需第一对检查者的判断或目标分数.

blocks.en: S2.5 Deterministic invariants
blocks.zh: S2.5 决定性的变量

blocks.en: The checker compares multisets, rather than only exact whole-document strings. Numeric patterns include signs, decimal and grouped digits, and percentages. Equations are normalized for whitespace and braces around a single subscript or superscript token. Author–year citations and numeric citations are extracted separately. Cross-reference spelling is normalized, for example “Fig. 1” and “Figure 1”, while preserving the referenced object and number. Markdown headings and Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) table blocks are also protected. For deletions, the declared whole paragraphs must occur in the original; only their protected tokens are permitted to disappear. These checks cannot detect all semantic changes, which is why semantic judgments and human sampling remain necessary.

blocks.en: Of 1,002 primary-checker passes in the second-provider sample, 30 are disputed. The author adjudicates all 30, finding 13 invalid and one uncertain, an invalid-or-uncertain rate of 46.7% [ 28.3 , 65.7 ] [28.3,65.7] for this selected disagreement set. The 13 invalid items comprise five changed claims, three changes in claim strength, four incoherent edits, and one mis-scoped removal. Twenty-two of the 30 also pass the invariant check, and hence can enter an admitted edit bank or endpoint; ten are invalid and one uncertain. Two disputed shams are judged invalid because they cut text mid-sentence. This is evidence about the editing pipeline as executed, even though the writer was instructed to delete whole paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 在第二提供者抽样的1 002个初级检查员通行证中,有30个有争议。 提交人裁定所有30人,认为13人无效,1人不确定,就这一套选定的分歧裁定46.7%[28.3、65.7][28.3、65.7]。 13件无效物品包括5件变更的索赔、3件变更索赔数量、4件不一致的编辑和1件错划的删除。 30人中有22人也通过了无变化支票,因此可以进入一个被认可的编辑库或终点;10人无效,1人不确定。 两个有争议的骗局被判定无效,因为它们削减了文本的中期判决. 这是编辑管道被执行的证据,尽管作者被指示删除整段.

blocks.en: The disagreement adjudication covers 29 additional items after the 99-item audit, because one disputed item is already included there. Unlike the blind audit, the adjudicator may view the second checker’s objection after an initial read. The observed 14 invalid-or-uncertain disputes among 1,002 primary passes are about 1.4%; this is the fraction identified through that dispute pathway, not a complete error-rate estimate.
blocks.zh: 争议裁决涉及99个项目审计后增加的29个项目,因为有一个有争议的项目已经列入其中。 与盲目审计不同,裁判员可在初读后查看第二检查员的异议. 在1 002个主要通行证中观察到的14个无效或不确定的争端约为1.4%;这是通过该争端途径确定的一小部分,而不是一个完整的误差率估计。

blocks.en: The cross-provider recheck covers 1,323 items and agrees with the primary checker on 86.6%. Among items passed by the primary checker, the second provider passes 97.0%; among items passed by the second provider, the primary checker passes 86.9%. This asymmetry indicates that the primary checker is stricter in this sample, not that it is always correct. A 20-item challenge deliberately changes claims, hedges, attributions, or aims while preserving numbers. The primary checker rejects all 20. This tests those designed corruptions and does not estimate the miss rate for natural edits.
blocks.zh: 交叉提供者重新检查涉及1 323项,同意86.6%的主要检查。 在主检票人通过的物品中,第二个供应商通过97.0%;在第二个供应商通过的物品中,主要检查人通过86.9%。 这种不对称性表明,本样中主检查器更为严格,而不是总是正确. 20项质疑在保留数字的同时故意更改债权,套期,归属,或目的. 主检查器拒绝所有20。 这测试了那些设计出的腐败,并且没有估计自然编辑的误差率.

Tables S4 – S7 provide the descriptive results underlying the main figures. All standardized changes use the fixed SDs from the 328 originals. Different intervention rows can have different paper cohorts. In particular, a paired removal-minus-sham estimate must be computed on its 93 paired papers rather than by subtracting marginal means on 102 and 184 papers.

Oracle-minus-choice regret is the score difference between the oracle’s edit and the proxy’s edit, averaged within paper. We average draws within each paper before bootstrap resampling, so draws and edits do not become independent sampling units.
blocks.zh: 每份原始的忠诚书都同等贡献. 我们为每张纸和银行规模独立抽取1000个银行,在每家银行内部进行未经更换的采样编辑,使用20261031种子与纸面标识和银行规模相结合的确定性方法. 在每次抽图中,选择器下的目标变化与精确抽查的银行的平均变化相比较。 代理和兄弟姐妹选择者只使用各自的分数;甲骨文使用被评价的目标本身. 绑定使用记录编辑顺序. Oracle-minus-choice遗憾是Oracle编辑与代理编辑的分数差, 我们平均在每张纸中抽取后再重新取样,所以抽取和编辑不会成为独立的采样单位.

blocks.en: All 198 fidelity papers support banks of five. The 160 papers with at least fifteen admitted edits form the fixed cohort for sizes five, ten, and fifteen. Figure S7 holds that cohort constant. Conditional on the observed banks, the aggregate Monte Carlo standard error for each displayed mean is at most 0.00021 target SD, smaller than the displayed paper-bootstrap uncertainty; the latter intervals do not include this simulation error. The median original bank size is seventeen. Results for the complete, variable-sized banks remain in Table S6 and must not be compared with the five-edit estimates as if only the chooser changed.

blocks.en: The score lost by choosing with a proxy rather than the evaluated target also varies by paper (Figure 3 c, d); in 32-bit, its mean for surrogate choice is 0.078 SD on T 1 T_{1} and 0.054 SD on T 2 T_{2} . Increasing the sampled bank size from five to fifteen on the same 160 papers increases the oracle advantage, while all surrogate- and sibling-choice intervals still span zero (Supplementary Figure S7 ). Holding bank size fixed therefore preserves the descriptive finding that these proxies add little over random choice. It does not test a surrogate trained specifically to predict edit responses.
blocks.zh: 通过选择代理而不是被评价的目标而损失的分数也因纸而异(图3 c,d);在32位中,其代选的平均值为T1 T_{1}上的0.078 SD和T2 T_{2}上的0.054 SD. 将同一160份论文上的银行样本从5份增加到15份,增加了甲骨文的优势,而所有代孕和姐妹选择间隔仍然为零(补充图S7)。 因此,持有固定的银行规模保留了描述性结论,即这些代理人很少增加随机选择。 它不测试一个经过专门培训的代理来预测编辑响应.

blocks.en: The oracle advantage and oracle-minus-proxy regret are nonnegative by their definitions. They quantify response variation in finite banks, rather than evidence that any edit improves scientific quality, or a performance guarantee for new banks. A proxy advantage near zero means that it does little better on average than random selection from these same available alternatives.
blocks.zh: 甲骨文的优势和甲骨文的-负负负负的悔恨因它们的定义而不可否定. 它们量化了有限库存中的反应变化,而不是证明任何编辑会提高科学质量,或为新库存提供业绩保障。 近于零的代理优势意味着,平均来说,它比从这些相同的可用替代品中随机选择好不了多少。

blocks.en: S6.4 Reliability of target edit responses

blocks.en: We rescored a seeded sample of 25 Study 2 fidelity papers (seed 20261101) on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 with the same pipeline, software versions and bfloat16 forward pass. The sample covers the 25 originals, their 438 admitted single edits, and five whitespace-only null edits per paper; each null edit widens one sentence gap from one space to two. For all 463 originals and real edits shared with the RTX 4090 run, token counts match. Repeated scoring of ten originals on the same GPU is bit-identical. Edit-response correlations use the estimand and bootstrap of Equation 1 , with RTX 4090 and RTX 5090 changes in place of the two evaluators (Table S13 ).

blocks.en: Table S13: Reliability of target edit responses on 25 Study 2 papers (post hoc). RTX 5090 rescoring is compared with the RTX 4090 scores used throughout the paper; a further 32-bit run on the RTX 4090 separates precision from hardware. Original-score correlations are Pearson correlations across the 25 papers; edit correlations are mean within-paper Spearman correlations ( Spearman, 1904 ) with nominal 95% paper-bootstrap confidence intervals (CIs). Absolute changes pool the 438 real edits or 125 null edits, in each target’s original-score standard deviation (SD); null edits widen one sentence gap and change no word.

blocks.en: Original-paper scores agree closely across GPUs: Pearson correlations are 0.9985 for T 1 T_{1} and 0.9993 for T 2 T_{2} , and the mean absolute probability difference is 0.009 for both. Edit changes reproduce less well because they are small, with mean absolute sizes on the RTX 5090 of 0.078 SD for T 1 T_{1} and 0.055 SD for T 2 T_{2} . The within-paper correlation between the two GPUs’ edit changes is 0.681 ​ [ 0.604 , 0.755 ] 0.681\;[0.604,\,0.755] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.658 ​ [ 0.603 , 0.712 ] 0.658\;[0.603,\,0.712] for T 2 T_{2} . Whitespace-only edits move T 1 T_{1} by 0.052 SD and T 2 T_{2} by 0.034 SD, about two thirds of the real-edit movement. They move S S by 0.002 SD. Each whitespace edit adds one token, so this checks formatting sensitivity rather than repeated scoring of identical inputs.

blocks.en: For a descriptive sensitivity calculation, assume independent classical measurement errors, no measurement error in S S , and that the cross-GPU correlations estimate target reliability. Under these assumptions, agreement with each target is attenuated by the square root of its reliability. Dividing the primary upper limits by these factors, using unrounded estimates, gives 0.031 and 0.027. Dividing the sibling upper limit of 0.075 by the square root of the product of both reliabilities gives 0.112. This scaling is approximate for averaged rank correlations and rests on 25 papers; using the lower reliability limits gives 0.033, 0.028 and 0.124. The scaled endpoints are not noise-corrected confidence bounds: the error model is unverified and reliability uncertainty is not propagated. On this subset, agreement between S S and each target stays near zero with the RTX 5090 scores: 0.016 ​ [ − 0.072 , 0.098 ] 0.016\;[-0.072,\,0.098] for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.028 ​ [ − 0.108 , 0.050 ] -0.028\;[-0.108,\,0.050] for T 2 T_{2} .
