blocks.en: Scoring the whole model in 32-bit floating point changes the targets more than changing GPU. Original scores shift by a mean absolute probability difference of 0.089 for T 1 T_{1} and 0.175 for T 2 T_{2} . Edit changes correlate with the RTX 4090 changes at 0.379 ​ [ 0.266 , 0.483 ] 0.379\;[0.266,\,0.483] and 0.455 ​ [ 0.366 , 0.538 ] 0.455\;[0.366,\,0.538] . Agreement with S S stays near zero: 0.022 ​ [ − 0.082 , 0.126 ] 0.022\;[-0.082,\,0.126] and 0.029 ​ [ − 0.071 , 0.131 ] 0.029\;[-0.071,\,0.131] . To separate precision from hardware, we repeat the 32-bit scoring of all 588 inputs on the RTX 4090. The 32-bit edit changes of the two GPUs correlate at 0.9997 ​ [ 0.9994 , 1.000 ] 0.9997\;[0.9994,\,1.000] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.9998 ​ [ 0.9995 , 1.000 ] 0.9998\;[0.9995,\,1.000] for T 2 T_{2} , and the RTX 4090 32-bit changes correlate with its own bfloat16 changes at 0.380 and 0.455, as the RTX 5090 32-bit changes do. The lower cross-precision reliability therefore reflects bfloat16 rounding, not hardware: the bfloat16 changes carry a component, partly shared across GPUs, that the 32-bit model does not produce. In 32-bit, whitespace-only edits still move T 1 T_{1} by 0.026 SD and T 2 T_{2} by 0.015 SD, about half of the real-edit movement (0.055 and 0.030 SD). On these 25 papers, 32-bit target agreement is − 0.043 ​ [ − 0.176 , 0.084 ] -0.043\;[-0.176,\,0.084] .

On the 1,667-paper benchmark, a 32-bit pass on the RTX 4090 gives AUCs of 0.713 ​ [ 0.688 , 0.736 ] 0.713\;[0.688,\,0.736] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.666 ​ [ 0.640 , 0.691 ] 0.666\;[0.640,\,0.691] for T 2 T_{2} , against 0.720 and 0.670 in bfloat16. Paper rankings change little across precisions (Spearman 0.909 for T 1 T_{1} and 0.983 for T 2 T_{2} ), although 32-bit lowers the mean predicted acceptance from 0.499 to 0.477 and from 0.573 to 0.409. Original-paper agreement persists in 32-bit: S S ’s Spearman correlation is 0.680 with T 1 T_{1} and 0.509 with T 2 T_{2} (0.731 and 0.547 in bfloat16), and the two targets correlate at 0.625 (0.626).

Primary estimand in 32-bit. We rescore the 200 Study 2 originals and 3,323 admitted single edits with both targets in 32-bit on the RTX 4090. With S S ’s changes unchanged, the mean within-paper agreement on the 198 fidelity papers is − 0.008 ​ [ − 0.047 , 0.031 ] -0.008\;[-0.047,\,0.031] for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.021 ​ [ − 0.059 , 0.016 ] -0.021\;[-0.059,\,0.016] for T 2 T_{2} , against − 0.008 ​ [ − 0.041 , 0.025 ] -0.008\;[-0.041,\,0.025] and − 0.015 ​ [ − 0.052 , 0.022 ] -0.015\;[-0.052,\,0.022] in bfloat16 (Table 4 ). The targets agree at 0.047 ​ [ 0.004 , 0.090 ] 0.047\;[0.004,\,0.090] in 32-bit, against 0.033 in bfloat16. Within papers, the bfloat16 edit changes correlate with the 32-bit changes at 0.284 ​ [ 0.245 , 0.321 ] 0.284\;[0.245,\,0.321] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.496 ​ [ 0.461 , 0.530 ] 0.496\;[0.461,\,0.530] for T 2 T_{2} . Averaged within papers, the 32-bit edit changes are 0.056 and 0.040 of each target’s 32-bit SD across the 200 originals (0.242 and 0.257), against 0.082 and 0.050 in bfloat16. Because 32-bit scores reproduce across GPUs, these estimates carry little of the rounding error that the scaled endpoints above approximate, and they supersede that scaling. Supplementary Section S5 gives the evidence-removal contrast in 32-bit.

Search in 32-bit. We rescore the 128 Study 3 originals, the 683 admitted search endpoints, and the 128 polished versions with both targets in 32-bit on the RTX 4090, and repeat the pre-specified contrast with the frozen endpoints. In units of each target’s 32-bit SD across the 328 study originals (0.244 and 0.256), adaptive minus random gain at Q = 512 Q=512 is − 0.015 ​ [ − 0.033 , 0.001 ] -0.015\;[-0.033,\,0.001] for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.006 ​ [ − 0.022 , 0.009 ] -0.006\;[-0.022,\,0.009] for T 2 T_{2} , against 0.002 and − 0.001 -0.001 in bfloat16. Adaptive gains over the original are − 0.011 ​ [ − 0.034 , 0.011 ] -0.011\;[-0.034,\,0.011] and − 0.005 ​ [ − 0.028 , 0.016 ] -0.005\;[-0.028,\,0.016] , and random gains 0.004 ​ [ − 0.014 , 0.022 ] 0.004\;[-0.014,\,0.022] and 0.001 ​ [ − 0.015 , 0.018 ] 0.001\;[-0.015,\,0.018] .

Float16, a proxy for the release recipe. The release serves its 32-bit weights through vLLM, whose default runs them in float16. To approximate that recipe, we rescore the 200 Study 2 originals and 3,323 admitted single edits with a float16 forward pass in Transformers on the RTX 4090, reading the decision in 32-bit as before; no score is non-finite. Within papers, the float16 edit changes correlate with the 32-bit changes at 0.978 ​ [ 0.974 , 0.982 ] 0.978\;[0.974,\,0.982] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.976 ​ [ 0.972 , 0.979 ] 0.976\;[0.972,\,0.979] for T 2 T_{2} , but with the bfloat16 changes at only 0.281 ​ [ 0.242 , 0.319 ] 0.281\;[0.242,\,0.319] and 0.499 ​ [ 0.464 , 0.534 ] 0.499\;[0.464,\,0.534] . With float16 targets, edit fidelity on the 198 fidelity papers is − 0.004 ​ [ − 0.043 , 0.036 ] -0.004\;[-0.043,\,0.036] for T 1 T_{1} and − 0.026 ​ [ − 0.063 , 0.012 ] -0.026\;[-0.063,\,0.012] for T 2 T_{2} , and the targets agree at 0.045 ​ [ 0.003 , 0.087 ] 0.045\;[0.003,\,0.087] , as in 32-bit. On the 1,667-paper benchmark, float16 gives AUCs of 0.713 for T 1 T_{1} and 0.666 for T 2 T_{2} . Each point estimate differs from 32-bit by less than 0.0002, and both paired-bootstrap CIs include zero. Its paper scores have Spearman correlations of at least 0.9999 with the 32-bit scores. vLLM’s kernels may round differently, so this pass approximates the recipe rather than reproducing it.

Prompt swap. The targets differ in weights and in prompt. To separate the two, we rescore the 200 Study 2 originals and 3,323 admitted single edits with T 1 T_{1} in float16 under T 2 T_{2} ’s arXiv preamble instead of its own ICLR preamble (Supplementary Section S1 ). On the 198 fidelity papers, T 1 T_{1} ’s edit changes under the swapped prompt agree with T 2 T_{2} ’s at 0.067 ​ [ 0.027 , 0.107 ] 0.067\;[0.027,\,0.107] , against 0.045 ​ [ 0.003 , 0.087 ] 0.045\;[0.003,\,0.087] under its own prompt, and with S S ’s at − 0.016 ​ [ − 0.054 , 0.022 ] -0.016\;[-0.054,\,0.022] . The prompt therefore does not account for the targets’ disagreement. The swap leaves T 1 T_{1} ’s paper rankings almost unchanged (Spearman 0.986 on the 200 originals; 0.564 with T 2 T_{2} , against 0.562), yet its edit changes under the two prompts agree at only 0.537 ​ [ 0.497 , 0.575 ] 0.537\;[0.497,\,0.575] : within one set of weights, a change of instructions preserves paper rankings and reorders the edits.
blocks.zh: 快速交换。 目标在重量和速度上各不相同。 为了将两者分开,我们将200个研究2的正本和3,323个接受单版编辑的T1 T_{1}在T2 T_{2}的ArXiv序言下以浮标16,而不是它自己的ICLR序言(补充部分S1). 在198份忠诚论文上,T 1 T_{1}在互换的提示下编辑的更改与T 2 T_{2}在0.067 [0.027, 0.107] 0.067\;[0.027,\ 0.0107],相对在0.045 [0.003, 0.087] 0.045\;[0.003,\ 0.087] 在自己的提示下,与S 的编辑更改与0.016 [0.054, 0.022] - 0.016\;[0.054,\ 0.022]. 因此,这一及时性并不说明目标有分歧。 互换让T 1 TQQQ1}的纸张排名几乎保持不变(在200份原件上是Spearman 0.986;用T 2 TQQX2}0.564,对0.562),然而在两个提示下的编辑变化却只同意0.537 [0.497,0.575] 0.537\;[0.497,\,0.575]:在一套加权数内,指令的更改保留了纸张的排名,并重新安排了编辑顺序.

blocks.en: Fixed banks in 32-bit. We repeat the five-edit bank analysis of Section 4.3 with the 32-bit target changes, using the same banks, draws, and seeds; the bfloat16 run reproduces the reported values exactly. Choosing with the evaluated target gives 0.076 ​ [ 0.071 , 0.082 ] 0.076\;[0.071,\,0.082] SD for T 1 T_{1} and 0.052 ​ [ 0.047 , 0.058 ] 0.052\;[0.047,\,0.058] for T 2 T_{2} , against 0.101 and 0.061 in bfloat16. Surrogate choice gives − 0.002 ​ [ − 0.005 , 0.002 ] -0.002\;[-0.005,\,0.002] and − 0.001 ​ [ − 0.004 , 0.001 ] -0.001\;[-0.004,\,0.001] , and sibling choice stays within 0.005 SD of random choice. On the 160-paper cohort, the 32-bit oracle advantage rises from 0.076 to 0.120 for T 1 T_{1} and from 0.049 to 0.077 for T 2 T_{2} as banks grow from five to fifteen edits. An oracle that chooses with bfloat16 scores but is evaluated in 32-bit keeps 0.024 ​ [ 0.020 , 0.029 ] 0.024\;[0.020,\,0.029] and 0.030 ​ [ 0.026 , 0.035 ] 0.030\;[0.026,\,0.035] SD: the reduced-precision oracle partly selects rounding error, while the 32-bit oracle advantage stays well above the proxies’.

Whitespace twins in 32-bit. To measure how reproducible the 32-bit edit responses are, we pair each admitted single edit of a seeded 60 of the 198 fidelity papers (seed 20261102; 1,000 edits) with a twin: the same edited text with one sentence gap widened from one space to two. The gap is drawn among sentence boundaries between characters 2,000 and 30,000 and at least 200 characters from the changed span, so the twin leaves the edit intact. Both targets score the twins in 32-bit on the RTX 4090; S S scores them on the CPU. The within-paper correlation between each edit’s change and its twin’s change is 0.760 ​ [ 0.713 , 0.804 ] 0.760\;[0.713,\,0.804] for T 1 T_{1} , 0.743 ​ [ 0.692 , 0.783 ] 0.743\;[0.692,\,0.783] for T 2 T_{2} , and 0.960 ​ [ 0.949 , 0.970 ] 0.960\;[0.949,\,0.970] for S S , although the added space moves the targets by 0.032 and 0.020 SD per edit, against edit changes of 0.058 and 0.036 SD (0.78 and 0.52 against 1.40 and 0.93 points of acceptance score). If these correlations serve as reliability proxies under independent-error assumptions, the classical attenuation relation r a ​ r b \sqrt{r_{a}r_{b}} ( Spearman, 1904 ) gives illustrative ceilings of 0.854 for S S – T 1 T_{1} , 0.845 for S S – T 2 T_{2} , and 0.752 for T 1 T_{1} – T 2 T_{2} (0.823, 0.811, and 0.703 at the lower interval limits). On the same papers the observed agreements are − 0.037 ​ [ − 0.109 , 0.037 ] -0.037\;[-0.109,\,0.037] , − 0.030 ​ [ − 0.107 , 0.048 ] -0.030\;[-0.107,\,0.048] , and 0.036 ​ [ − 0.034 , 0.105 ] 0.036\;[-0.034,\,0.105] . blocks.en: Above-floor edits, a distilled surrogate, and topic (post hoc, saved scores). Taking the 95th percentile of the added-space change over the 1,000 twins as a floor (0.093 SD for T 1 T_{1} and 0.071 for T 2 T_{2} in 32-bit), 672 edits on 157 papers exceed it for T 1 T_{1} and 558 on 127 papers for T 2 T_{2} ; on the 62 and 50 papers with at least five such edits (417 and 396 edits), their agreement with S S is 0.050 ​ [ − 0.068 , 0.166 ] 0.050\;[-0.068,\,0.166] and − 0.045 ​ [ − 0.166 , 0.078 ] -0.045\;[-0.166,\,0.078] . With the median as floor, it is − 0.016 ​ [ − 0.063 , 0.032 ] -0.016\;[-0.063,\,0.032] on 181 papers and − 0.039 ​ [ − 0.086 , 0.006 ] -0.039\;[-0.086,\,0.006] on 177, and the targets agree at 0.052 ​ [ − 0.011 , 0.113 ] 0.052\;[-0.011,\,0.113] on 158; only three papers have five edits above both 95th-percentile floors. A ridge model on S S ’s input features, fitted to each target’s 32-bit scores of the 1,339 benchmark papers outside the 328 study originals (penalty by five-fold cross-validation), ranks the 198 held-out fidelity originals at 0.645 with T 1 T_{1} and 0.701 with T 2 T_{2} , yet its edit changes agree with the targets’ 32-bit changes at only − 0.002 ​ [ − 0.043 , 0.039 ] -0.002\;[-0.043,\,0.039] and 0.033 ​ [ − 0.003 , 0.071 ] 0.033\;[-0.003,\,0.071] . Clustering the titles and abstracts of the 1,667 benchmark papers into 10, 20, or 40 topics (k-means on a separate TF–IDF) leaves S S ’s agreement with T 1 T_{1} at 0.72 within topics (0.73 pooled) and at 0.57–0.58 when the structure counts are also residualized (0.60 pooled); for T 2 T_{2} the values are 0.57–0.58 (0.55) and 0.24 (0.23). Topics explain 2–8% of the rank variance of each score. The clusters approximate topic; the venue’s own subject areas were not used.
S6.5 Additional post hoc analyses
blocks.zh: S6.5 额外员额分析

blocks.en: These descriptive analyses were run after the four pre-specified tests and are outside that family. Most reuse saved scores; the positive control scores newly damaged texts with the paper’s pipeline, and the dense surrogate trains a new classifier, with both configurations fixed before their outcomes were examined. Table S14 collects them. Intervals are nominal 95% paper-bootstrap intervals (seed 0; 10,000 resamples for agreement on the 25-paper subset, 2,000 for the pooled and between-paper correlations).
blocks.zh: 这些描述性分析是在四个预先规定的测试之后进行的,并且不在家庭之外。 大多数再利用节省的分数;正控用纸张的管道对新损坏的文本进行分数,密集的代孕者训练一个新的分数器,在检查结果之前固定两种配置。 表S14收集它们。 间隔是名义上的95%的纸-布图间隔(种子0;10 000份关于25张纸子集的协议复制件,2 000份关于集合和纸张间关联)。

blocks.en: Target agreement and reliability. On the 25 rescored papers, the two targets’ within-paper edit agreement stays near zero under every scoring: RTX 4090 bfloat16, RTX 5090 bfloat16, and RTX 5090 32-bit (Table S14 ). On the 125 whitespace-only edits of the same papers, their agreement is 0.136 ​ [ − 0.060 , 0.320 ] 0.136\;[-0.060,\,0.320] ; S S ’s whitespace changes are identical within each paper, so its null-edit agreement is undefined. Real edits vary more than whitespace edits: the variance of real-edit changes exceeds the null-edit variance by 59% of the real-edit variance for T 1 T_{1} and 65% for T 2 T_{2} . Replacing the cross-GPU reliabilities of Section S6.4 with the cross-precision values (0.379 and 0.455) scales the primary upper limits to 0.041 and 0.032 for S S and to 0.180 between the targets, under the same unverified error model; the direct 32-bit estimates in Section S6.4 supersede this scaling. On the 198 fidelity papers, the targets’ original-paper scores correlate at 0.603 ​ [ 0.501 , 0.688 ] 0.603\;[0.501,\,0.688] (Spearman; seed 20261031).

blocks.en: What moves each scorer. Within papers, we regress each scorer’s standardized edit change on the character-count change, its absolute value, the paragraph’s relative position, whether the paragraph lies outside the surrogate’s window, and the edit type, after subtracting paper means. These descriptors explain 1.0% of the within-paper variance of S S ’s changes and 0.2% and 0.4% for the bfloat16 changes of T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} (0.8% and 0.4% in 32-bit); for absolute changes, 16.0%, 3.8%, and 2.2%. The absolute size of an edit’s character change correlates with the absolute score change at 0.32 for S S and 0.18 and 0.15 for the targets. No admitted single edit truncates a target input.
blocks.zh: 是什么动了每个计分员。 在纸面上,我们将每个记分员的标准化编辑更改的字符计数变化、其绝对值、段落的相对位置、段落是否位于替代者窗口之外、编辑类型,再减去纸张的含义。 这些描述词解释了S S 变化的1.0%的纸内差异,T 1 T_{1}和T 2 T_{2}的浮点16变化的0.2%和0.4%(以32位表示0.8%和0.4%);绝对变化的16.0%、3.8%和2.2%。 编辑的绝对大小变化与绝对分数变化有关,S S为0.32,目标为0.18,0.15。 没有被允许的单一编辑切换目标输入 。

blocks.en: Levels of analysis. On the 1,667 benchmark papers, S S ’s Spearman correlation with T 1 T_{1} is 0.731, and 0.602 after ranking out the structure counts (length, figures, tables, equations, headings, citations, title and abstract length) from both scores. With T 2 T_{2} it falls from 0.547 to 0.226; the structure-only score alone correlates at 0.511 with T 1 T_{1} and 0.579 with T 2 T_{2} . blocks.en: Estimand comparison and heterogeneity. Yang et al. (2026b) report between-paper Pearson correlations of whole-paper gains. Pooling all 3,321 fidelity edits gives Pearson correlations of 0.018, 0.024, and 0.025 for S S – T 1 T_{1} , S S – T 2 T_{2} , and T 1 T_{1} – T 2 T_{2} ; correlating each paper’s mean change across the 198 papers gives 0.099, 0.107, and 0.003, all with intervals spanning zero (Table S14 ). Yang等人(2026年b)报告皮尔逊论文之间关于整篇论文收益的相关性. 集合所有3,321个忠诚编辑,皮尔逊的关联性为0.018、0.024和0.025,分别是S – 1 T_{1}、S S – 2 T_{2}和T 1 T_{1} – T 2 T_{2};在198份论文中,每份论文的平均变化为0.099、0.107和0.003,间隔均为零(表S14)。 纸质替代物-目标相关性的分布与纸质内部穿插无效(SD 0.244对T1 T_{1}0.256;T2 T_{2}0.264对0.257;2,000穿插)相匹配,而目标-目标相关性比无效预测(0.301对0.256;穿插p < 0.001 p < 0.001): 两个目标就一些文件达成一致,对另一些文件持不同意见。

blocks.en: Positive control. To check that the within-paper estimand can register agreement, we damage 50 fidelity papers (seed 20261101) in graded steps, without any language model. Each paper receives 12 versions: the word order is shuffled within k k paragraphs, or k k paragraphs are deleted, for k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 } k\in\{1,2,3,5,8,12\} . The sets are nested, and the paragraphs are body paragraphs of at least 40 words lying wholly inside S S ’s 30,000-character window. The targets are scored with the paper’s pipeline; rescoring the unedited originals reproduces their frozen scores exactly. Over the six deletions, the mean within-paper correlations are 0.651 ​ [ 0.555 , 0.742 ] 0.651\;[0.555,\,0.742] for S S – T 1 T_{1} , 0.530 ​ [ 0.391 , 0.656 ] 0.530\;[0.391,\,0.656] for S S – T 2 T_{2} , and 0.470 ​ [ 0.347 , 0.586 ] 0.470\;[0.347,\,0.586] for T 1 T_{1} – T 2 T_{2} (Table S14 ). The estimand therefore detects agreement when the edits share a graded signal. Deletion also shortens the paper, to which S S responds through its length features, so this control does not show that any scorer tracks content. Word shuffles separate the targets: shuffling 12 paragraphs lowers T 1 T_{1} by 0.407 SD on average but T 2 T_{2} by only 0.049 SD, and T 2 T_{2} ’s changes barely follow the number of shuffled paragraphs (within-paper correlation with severity 0.056 ​ [ − 0.133 , 0.241 ] 0.056\;[-0.133,\,0.241] , against 0.465 ​ [ 0.314 , 0.611 ] 0.465\;[0.314,\,0.611] for T 1 T_{1} ). Over the shuffles, S S – T 1 T_{1} agreement is 0.321 ​ [ 0.171 , 0.464 ] 0.321\;[0.171,\,0.464] and S S – T 2 T_{2} agreement 0.025 ​ [ − 0.137 , 0.185 ] 0.025\;[-0.137,\,0.185] .

blocks.en: T 2 T_{2} in its own venue. On the 1,415 papers of its balanced arXiv test split, the split of its model card, our bfloat16 implementation of T 2 T_{2} gives an AUC of 0.813 ​ [ 0.791 , 0.834 ] 0.813\;[0.791,\,0.834] , accuracy 72.7%, and a predicted acceptance rate of 46.6%, against 0.812, 72.8%, and 47% reported on its model card ( Konan et al., 2026a ) . We repeat the positive control on 50 of these papers (seed 20261103), with the same damage levels and paragraph rules, measuring changes in SD units of T 2 T_{2} ’s and S S ’s scores on the 1,415 papers. Over deletions, T 2 T_{2} ’s changes follow severity at 0.550 ​ [ 0.427 , 0.663 ] 0.550\;[0.427,\,0.663] and agree with S S at 0.546 ​ [ 0.424 , 0.658 ] 0.546\;[0.424,\,0.658] , as on ICLR papers (0.526 and 0.530). blocks.en: Editable features, edit descriptors, and a learned predictor (post hoc, saved scores). Of S S ’s 300,008 input columns, 142,086 change in at least one admitted fidelity edit; they carry 57% of the absolute weight. Restricted to them, S S ’s linear score ranks the 1,667 benchmark papers at 0.668 with T 1 T_{1} ’s 32-bit scores and 0.522 with T 2 T_{2} ’s, against 0.680 and 0.509 for the full linear score; the remaining columns give 0.221 and 0.053. With columns changed by at least ten edits the values are 0.628 and 0.496. The paper-level agreement therefore lies mostly in features the edits can change. For each edit we also measure, on the changed paragraphs, word overlap, the change in sentence count and mean sentence length, connectives, passive constructions, nominalizations, Flesch reading ease, and T 1 T_{1} ’s token count. Each correlates with the 32-bit target changes at most 0.06 within papers in absolute value (largest: token-count change with T 2 T_{2} , 0.060 ​ [ 0.006 , 0.114 ] 0.060\;[0.006,\,0.114] ); four of the 16 intervals exclude zero, all below 0.07. A ridge model on all descriptors, fitted to each target’s paper-demeaned 32-bit changes on half of the papers and evaluated on the other half (five splits), reaches 0.004 ​ [ − 0.025 , 0.032 ] 0.004\;[-0.025,\,0.032] for T 1 T_{1} and 0.025 ​ [ − 0.011 , 0.060 ] 0.025\;[-0.011,\,0.060] for T 2 T_{2} . Adding sentence embeddings of the old and new paragraphs (bge-small-en-v1.5; difference and new vector) gives − 0.006 ​ [ − 0.030 , 0.019 ] -0.006\;[-0.030,\,0.019] and 0.008 ​ [ − 0.025 , 0.042 ] 0.008\;[-0.025,\,0.042] . blocks.en: Edit-level readout. After the main analyses, we also score inputs with DeepReviewer-14B without generating reviews. Generating one review for each of the 3,523 Study 2 originals and single-edit versions alone would take about 55 hours at the observed mean of 56 seconds per review. The prompt keeps the Fast Mode system message and the model’s own opening of a Fast Mode answer, then jumps to the answer’s final fields. The primary readout, fixed on a 30-paper pilot before any edit was scored, is the expected leading digit of the rating after “ ## Rating: ”; the secondary readout is the log-probability difference between Accept and Reject after “ ## Decision: ”. Inputs are cut to 14,000 tokens as above. We score a seeded, label-balanced subset of 300 benchmark papers, the 200 Study 2 originals and 3,323 single edits, the 1,000 added-space versions of 60 papers, and the 500 single-paragraph scrambles of 50 papers. Changes are standardized by the readout’s SD over the 200 originals (0.32 rating points). A first run, in which the server reused computation cached from the previously scored input, made scores depend on scoring order; we discarded it. In the reported run, rescoring the 200 originals in reverse order reproduces every score exactly.
blocks.zh: 编辑级读取. 在主要分析之后,我们还在不产生评论的情况下,对DeepReviewer-14B进行评分。 仅为3,523份研究2正本和单版编写一份审查,就需约55小时,每次审查平均56秒。 提示保存了快模式系统消息和模型自己打开的快模式答案,然后跳到答案的最终字段. 在任何编辑得分之前固定在30页的试纸上的主读数是“□评分:......”之后的预期评分数字;第二读数是“□决定:......”之后接受和拒绝的对数概率差。 输入像上一样被削减到14,000个令牌. 我们得分的是300份基准论文的种子、标签平衡子集、200份研究2的原件和3 323份单一编辑、1 000份60份论文的新增空间版本和500份50份论文的单段拼音。 修改由读取的SD在200原版(0.32分)上标准化. 第一次运行,服务器从先前的评分输入中重复使用计算缓存,得分取决于评分顺序;我们放弃了它. 在报道的运行中,以反向顺序重评200位原声,准确地复制每个分数.

blocks.en: The rating readout separates accepted from rejected papers with an AUC of 0.679 ​ [ 0.620 , 0.738 ] 0.679\;[0.620,\,0.738] and ranks the 300 papers with S S , T 1 T_{1} , and T 2 T_{2} at Spearman 0.518, 0.531, and 0.330 (32-bit target scores). On the 198 fidelity papers, its edit changes agree with S S ’s at 0.003 ​ [ − 0.034 , 0.041 ] 0.003\;[-0.034,\,0.041] , with T 1 T_{1} ’s at − 0.012 ​ [ − 0.050 , 0.026 ] -0.012\;[-0.050,\,0.026] , and with T 2 T_{2} ’s at 0.022 ​ [ − 0.014 , 0.060 ] 0.022\;[-0.014,\,0.060] . A score that contained S S ’s at the observed correlation on the originals (Pearson 0.557) would, given the observed spread of both scorers’ changes, agree with S S at about 0.099 (simulation interval 0.061 to 0.137; Supplementary Section S6.5 ); the upper limit of 0.041 lies below this. The 25 papers longer than the input limit contain 14 edits outside it; each changes the score by exactly zero, and excluding them moves each estimate by less than 0.003. DeepReviewer’s edit responses are less stable than the targets’: an added space moves the readout by 0.062 SD against 0.079 SD for the same edits, and the two changes correlate within papers at 0.370 ​ [ 0.314 , 0.427 ] 0.370\;[0.314,\,0.427] . Under independent errors, this limits agreement to about 0.60 with S S and 0.53 with each target, far above the observed values. The positive control does not hold, however. The single-paragraph scrambles move the readout by 0.113 SD, yet its changes agree with neither target’s ( − 0.020 ​ [ − 0.104 , 0.066 ] -0.020\;[-0.104,\,0.066] and − 0.025 ​ [ − 0.110 , 0.055 ] -0.025\;[-0.110,\,0.055] ), whereas the targets agree with each other at 0.226 ​ [ 0.128 , 0.316 ] 0.226\;[0.128,\,0.316] . DeepReviewer therefore shares the targets’ response to none of the paragraph-level changes tested here, and this check cannot separate an absence of shared edit preferences from a readout that ranks such changes differently. The secondary decision readout separates papers weakly (AUC 0.562 ​ [ 0.494 , 0.626 ] 0.562\;[0.494,\,0.626] ) and agrees with no scorer on edits either (means from − 0.024 -0.024 to 0.003).

blocks.en: The executed study uses seed 20261029 for study sampling and audit sampling, with pilot seed 20261028, search seeds zero and one, and generative-reviewer seeds one and two. Study sampling excludes all 30 pilot papers. The operational sequence is edit generation, invariant and semantic checking, surrogate-only search, complete endpoint checks at 64 and 512, sampled second-provider checking, the corruption challenge, and freezing. Target scoring follows the freeze. The human audit and disagreement adjudication follow scoring; neither changes the four primary tests. The exploratory best-edit analysis is added after examining the main outcomes.
blocks.zh: 已执行研究使用20261029种子进行研究采样和审计采样,试验种子为20261028,搜索种子为零和1,基因审查种子为一和2. 研究抽样不包括所有30份试点文件。 操作序列是编辑生成,不常态和语义检查,仅代位搜索,在64和512时完成端点检查,抽样的第二提供者检查,腐败挑战,以及冻结. 目标分数跟随冻结。 人力审计和分歧裁决遵循评分制;两者都不改变四项主要测试。 在审查主要结果之后,增加了探索性最佳编辑分析。

blocks.en: There are 5,321 inputs: 328 originals, 3,323 single-edit versions, 102 evidence removals, 184 deletion controls, 128 polished versions, 683 checked composite endpoints, and 573 exploratory endpoints from the two smallest search budgets. The saved input list records every text and its order. Before target scoring, the program checks each text and the complete ordered list against the saved versions. These checks establish that the evaluation inputs remain unchanged; they do not establish public preregistration. Both targets produce finite scores for all 5,321 inputs.

blocks.en: The main study completes 456 writer tasks, 456 primary-checker tasks, 128 endpoint-checking tasks, 20 corruption-checking tasks, and one corruption-generation task: 1,061 tasks through the OpenAI-based tooling. Four tasks require one retry each, giving 1,065 logged attempts. The second-provider sample completes 59 tasks without retries. Recorded usage for the successful OpenAI-based attempts, excluding the second-provider sample, is approximately 37.68 million input tokens, including 15.46 million cached tokens, and 9.17 million output tokens. Their summed durations are approximately 28.77 hours, with parallel execution reducing wall time. Failed-attempt usage and duration are not retained and are excluded from these totals. These are study-generation and validation costs, not part of the 7-millisecond surrogate inference claim. They also exclude the pilot, artificial intelligence (AI) assistance with this article, and the generative-reviewer check. Each acceptance predictor scores the frozen set in approximately 2.1 hours on the RTX 4090. AI assistants supported implementation of the analysis and plotting scripts.
blocks.zh: 主要研究完成456项写作任务,456项初试任务,128项端点检查任务,20项腐败检查任务,1项腐败生成任务:通过基于OpenAI的工具操作完成1061项任务. 4项任务要求每个重试一次,进行1 065次记录。 第二提供者样本完成59项任务,没有重复。 以OpenAI为基础的成功尝试的记录使用量,不包括第二提供者样本,约为3768万个输入令牌,包括1546万个缓存令牌和917万个输出令牌. 其总长度约为28.77小时,同时执行缩短了墙壁时间. 尝试失败的用法和持续时间不保留,不列入这些总数。 这些是研究生成和鉴定费用,不是7毫升替代推断索赔的一部分。 他们还排除了飞行员,人工智能(AI)对本条的协助,以及基因审查员的检查. 每个接收预测器在大约2.1小时内对RTX 4090上的冷冻装置进行评分. 人工智能助理支持实施分析和设计脚本。

blocks.en: The initial design included more papers, whole-paper rewrite conditions, a human-validity gate before scoring, and a human-reviewer anchor. The executed design reduces the samples, drops whole-paper rewrite conditions after pilot failures, measures human validity after scoring, and omits the human anchor because suitable version-matched histories were not assembled. These departures narrow the claims and are reported rather than treated as completed protocol elements. None of the four primary tests is selected because its effect is positive.
blocks.zh: 最初的设计包括更多的论文,整纸重写条件,评分前的人体功用门,以及人文评审主播. 被执行的设计减少了样本,在飞行员失败后放弃整纸重写条件,在打分后衡量人的有效性,并省略了人锚,因为合适的版本匹配历史没有组装. 这些更改缩小了索赔的范围,并被报告,而不是作为已完成的议定书内容处理。 四个初级测试中没有一个选择是因为其效果为阳性.

blocks.en: For independent reconstruction, the essential records are source paper identifiers and split membership; the fixed family-filter rules and sampling seeds; the writer and checker model configurations; edit positions and admission decisions; search constraints and policy seeds; records of the exact input versions; evaluator prompts, truncation, and precision; scores; and paper-level aggregation rules. The planned release preserves these non-text records and analysis code while excluding source and edited manuscript text. Reobtaining model weights and source text remains subject to their original access and licensing terms.
blocks.zh: 就独立重建而言,基本记录是原始文件识别符和分裂成员;固定的家庭过滤规则和抽样种子;写作员和检查员模型配置;编辑位置和录取决定;搜索限制和政策种子;准确输入版本的记录;评价员提示、截图和精确度;分数;以及纸面汇总规则。 计划中的发布保存了这些非文本记录和分析代码,同时排除了来源和编辑的手稿文本. 保留模型重量和源文本仍须遵守原始访问和许可证条款。
